searchDocs.content: 布局用于提供跨多个页面的通用 UI 结构（如页眉、页脚、侧边栏）。  layouts/default.vue: 如果存在，则作为所有未指定布局的页面的默认布局。自定义布局: 在 layouts/ 下创建其他 .vue 文件，如 layouts/custom.vue。<slot />: 布局文件必须包含一个 <slot /> 组件，用于渲染当前页面的内容。应用布局: 在页面组件的 <script setup> 中使用 definePageMeta({ layout: 'layout-name' }) 来指定布局。'default' 可省略。也可以动态设置为 false 来禁用布局。

searchDocs.title: 示例代码​
searchDocs.content: <!-- layouts/default.vue --> <template> <div> <TheHeader /> <!-- Auto-imported component --> <main style="padding: 20px;"> <!-- Page content will be rendered here --> <slot /> </main> <footer style="margin-top: 20px; border-top: 1px solid #ccc; padding: 10px;" > Default Layout Footer </footer> </div> </template> <!-- layouts/custom.vue --> <template> <div style="background-color: lightblue;"> <header style="padding: 10px; background-color: darkblue; color: white;"> Custom Layout Header </header> <main style="padding: 20px;"> <slot /> <!-- Page content --> </main> </div> </template> <!-- pages/about.vue --> <script setup> definePageMeta({ layout: "custom", // Use layouts/custom.vue for this page }); </script> <template> <h1>About page using custom layout</h1> </template> <!-- pages/index.vue --> <!-- No definePageMeta needed, uses layouts/default.vue --> <template> <h1>Homepage using default layout</h1> </template>

searchDocs.title: 说明​
searchDocs.content: Nuxt 3 提供了多种管理共享状态的方式。  useState Composable: Nuxt 提供的内置响应式、SSR 友好的 Composable，用于在组件之间共享简单的状态。它创建的状态在服务器端渲染时会传递给客户端。需要一个唯一的 key。Pinia: 官方推荐的 Vue 状态管理库。Nuxt 提供了 @pinia/nuxt 模块，可以轻松集成，并支持 SSR。Provide/Inject: Vue 的标准依赖注入机制也可用于传递状态，但不直接支持 SSR 状态传递。

searchDocs.title: 示例代码​
searchDocs.content: useState​  // composables/useMyState.ts // Simple shared state across components, SSR-friendly export const useCounter = () => useState<number>('counter', () => 0); export const useUser = () => useState<User | null>('user', () => null); // Example with type // components/CounterDisplay.vue <template> <p>Counter (useState): {{ counter }}</p> </template> <script setup> const counter = useCounter(); </script> // components/CounterButton.vue <template> <button @click="counter++">Increment (useState)</button> </template> <script setup> const counter = useCounter(); </script>   Pinia​  安装: npm install pinia @pinia/nuxt 添加模块到 nuxt.config.ts: // nuxt.config.ts export default defineNuxtConfig({ modules: ["@pinia/nuxt"], }); 创建 Store: // stores/cart.ts import { defineStore } from "pinia"; export const useCartStore = defineStore("cart", { state: () => ({ items: [] as string[], count: 0, }), actions: { addItem(item: string) { this.items.push(item); this.count++; }, removeItem(itemToRemove: string) { this.items = this.items.filter((item) => item !== itemToRemove); this.count = this.items.length; // Recalculate count }, }, getters: { // Example getter // isEmpty: (state) => state.count === 0, }, }); 在组件中使用: // components/AddToCart.vue <template> <button @click="addToCart">Add Item to Cart (Pinia)</button> </template> <script setup> import { useCartStore } from "~/stores/cart"; // Path relative to root const cartStore = useCartStore(); const itemName = "Product " + Math.random().toString(36).substring(7); function addToCart() { cartStore.addItem(itemName); } </script> // components/CartDisplay.vue <template> <div> <h3>Cart (Pinia)</h3> <p>Items: {{ cartStore.count }}</p> <ul> <li v-for="(item, index) in cartStore.items" :key="index"> {{ item }} </li> </ul> </div> </template> <script setup> import { useCartStore } from "~/stores/cart"; const cartStore = useCartStore(); </script>

searchDocs.title: 说明​
searchDocs.content: 插件允许你在 Vue 应用初始化时运行代码。常用于：  注册全局组件或指令。添加 Vue 原型方法或全局属性。集成第三方库（如 UI 库、分析工具）。运行应用启动逻辑。文件名后缀 .client 或 .server 可指定插件仅在客户端或服务器端运行。

searchDocs.title: 示例代码​
searchDocs.content: // plugins/hello.ts (Runs on both server and client) export default defineNuxtPlugin((nuxtApp) => { // Access nuxtApp instance (context) console.log("My plugin is running!"); // Inject global helper nuxtApp.provide("hello", (name: string) => `Hello ${name}!`); // Can also do Vue app level things // nuxtApp.vueApp.directive(...) // nuxtApp.vueApp.component(...) }); // plugins/analytics.client.ts (Runs only on client) export default defineNuxtPlugin((nuxtApp) => { console.log("Client-side analytics plugin initialized"); // Initialize a client-side library like Google Analytics // e.g., ga.create('UA-XXXXX-Y', 'auto'); // Make analytics instance available globally (optional) // const analytics = setupAnalyticsLib(); // nuxtApp.provide('analytics', analytics); }); // Usage in a component: // <template> // <p>{{ $hello('World') }}</p> // </template> // <script setup> // const { $hello } = useNuxtApp(); // Access injected helper // console.log($hello('from script')); // </script>

searchDocs.title: 说明​
searchDocs.content: 路由中间件允许你在导航到某个路由之前执行逻辑。可用于权限检查、重定向、加载布局所需数据等。  命名: 文件名即中间件名 (e.g., middleware/auth.ts)。全局中间件: 文件名添加 .global 后缀 (e.g., middleware/logger.global.ts)，会对每次路由变化都执行。定义: 导出一个 defineNuxtRouteMiddleware 函数。应用: 在页面中使用 definePageMeta({ middleware: ['middleware-name'] })。在 nuxt.config.ts 的 router.options.middleware 中全局添加。在布局中设置 defineOptions({ middleware: '...' }) (不推荐)。 函数签名: (to, from) => {}，可以访问目标路由 to 和来源路由 from。导航控制: 可以返回 navigateTo('/login') 进行重定向，或不返回值/返回 true 以允许导航，或返回 false / abortNavigation() 中止导航。

searchDocs.title: 示例代码​
searchDocs.content: // middleware/auth.ts export default defineNuxtRouteMiddleware((to, from) => { const { $auth } = useNuxtApp(); // Assuming an auth status helper/plugin exists console.log(`Auth middleware running for route: ${to.path}`); // Example: Redirect to login if trying to access /admin and not logged in const isLoggedIn = !!useUser().value; // Example using useState for user state if (to.path.startsWith("/admin") && !isLoggedIn) { console.log("User not logged in, redirecting to /login"); return navigateTo("/login?redirect=" + to.fullPath); // Redirect to login page } // Allow navigation otherwise // return true; // or just return nothing }); // middleware/logger.global.ts (Runs on every route change) export default defineNuxtRouteMiddleware((to, from) => { console.log( `[Global Middleware] Navigating from ${from.fullPath} to ${to.fullPath}` ); }); // Apply 'auth' middleware to a page // pages/admin/index.vue // <script setup> // definePageMeta({ // middleware: 'auth' // or ['auth'] // }); // </script>

searchDocs.title: 10. 服务器引擎 (Nitro) & API 路由 (server/)​
说明​
searchDocs.content: Nuxt 3 使用 Nitro 作为其服务器引擎。Nitro 提供了强大的后端能力，包括：  API 路由 (server/api/): 在此目录下创建文件，可以自动创建 API 端点。文件名即路由路径，支持 HTTP 方法 (通过文件后缀 .get.ts, .post.ts 或在文件中判断 event.node.req.method)。服务器路由 (server/routes/): 创建更复杂的服务器路由，支持自定义参数。服务器中间件 (server/middleware/): 在处理 API 或服务器路由请求之前执行的逻辑（如日志、认证、请求预处理）。会应用于所有服务器请求。服务器插件 (server/plugins/): 在 Nitro 服务器启动时运行，用于设置数据库连接、初始化服务等。工具函数 (server/utils/): 存放仅在服务器端使用的工具函数。上下文 (event): 处理函数接收一个 event 对象，包含请求 (event.node.req) 和响应 (event.node.res) 信息，以及 Nitro 提供的辅助函数 (readBody, getQuery, sendRedirect 等)。

searchDocs.title: 示例代码​
searchDocs.content: // server/api/hello.ts (Handles all methods by default) // Responds to GET /api/hello?name=Nuxt import { H3Event } from "h3"; // Nitro uses H3 for routing/event handling export default defineEventHandler((event: H3Event) => { const query = getQuery(event); // Helper to get query parameters const name = query.name || "World"; console.log( `[Server API] /api/hello called. Method: ${event.node.req.method}` ); if (event.node.req.method === "POST") { // const body = await readBody(event); // Helper to read request body // Handle POST logic... return { message: `Hello ${name}! (POST received)` }; } return { message: `Hello ${name}! (GET request)` }; }); // server/api/items.get.ts (Handles only GET requests to /api/items) let itemsDb = ["Apple", "Banana"]; // Dummy data store export default defineEventHandler(() => { console.log("[Server API] GET /api/items"); return { items: itemsDb }; }); // server/api/items.post.ts (Handles only POST requests to /api/items) export default defineEventHandler(async (event) => { try { const body = await readBody(event); if (body && body.item) { itemsDb.push(body.item); console.log(`[Server API] POST /api/items - Added: ${body.item}`); return { success: true, item: body.item }; } else { // Set response status code event.node.res.statusCode = 400; return { success: false, message: "Item is required in body" }; } } catch (e) { event.node.res.statusCode = 400; return { success: false, message: "Invalid request body" }; } }); // server/middleware/logger.ts (Nitro server middleware) export default defineEventHandler((event) => { const startTime = Date.now(); console.log( `[Server Middleware] New request: ${event.node.req.method} ${event.node.req.url}` ); // Modify response after handler execution (example) event.node.res.on("finish", () => { const duration = Date.now() - startTime; console.log( `[Server Middleware] Request finished: ${event.node.res.statusCode} in ${duration}ms` ); }); });

searchDocs.title: 说明​
searchDocs.content: assets/: 用于存放需要通过构建流程处理的源文件。例如，Sass 文件会被编译成 CSS，图片会被优化，字体会被处理。引用时使用相对路径或 ~/assets/ 别名，构建后路径会包含哈希值以利于缓存。public/: 用于存放必须保持原始名称且不需要处理的静态文件。文件会被直接复制到输出目录的根路径。适合放 robots.txt, favicon.ico, 不可变图片等。引用时直接使用绝对路径 / (相对于根目录)。

searchDocs.title: 示例代码​
searchDocs.content: <template> <div> <!-- Image from assets (processed by build tools) --> <img src="~/assets/images/logo.png" alt="Processed Logo" /> <div class="my-styled-div">Styled with assets CSS</div> <!-- Image from public (served directly) --> <img src="/brand-logo.svg" alt="Public Logo" /> <!-- Link to a file in public --> <a href="/documents/terms.pdf" target="_blank">Terms (PDF)</a> </div> </template> <style scoped> /* Example importing from assets */ @import "~/assets/css/variables.css"; .my-styled-div { color: var(--primary-color); /* Using variable from imported CSS */ /* Background image from assets */ background-image: url("~/assets/images/background.jpg"); } </style> <!-- Assumes: --> <!-- assets/images/logo.png --> <!-- assets/images/background.jpg --> <!-- assets/css/variables.css --> <!-- public/brand-logo.svg --> <!-- public/documents/terms.pdf -->

searchDocs.title: 说明​
searchDocs.content: Nuxt 的主要配置文件，用于定制框架行为、添加模块、设置元数据、配置构建选项等。使用 TypeScript (.ts) 文件可以获得类型提示。  defineNuxtConfig: 辅助函数，提供类型安全和自动补全。常用配置项: ssr: 启用/禁用服务器端渲染。devtools: 启用/禁用 Nuxt DevTools。modules: 注册 Nuxt 模块。css: 全局注入 CSS 文件。vite / webpack: 配置底层构建工具。runtimeConfig: 定义可在运行时访问的环境变量（区分公共和私有）。app: 配置应用元数据（head, pageTransition, layoutTransition）。routeRules: 定义路由级别的渲染和缓存规则。nitro: 配置 Nitro 服务器引擎。alias: 定义路径别名。

searchDocs.title: 示例代码 (nuxt.config.ts)​
searchDocs.content: import { defineNuxtConfig } from "nuxt/config"; export default defineNuxtConfig({ devtools: { enabled: true }, // Enable SSR (default) ssr: true, // Global CSS css: [ "~/assets/css/main.css", // Path relative to source directory (srcDir) ], // Modules modules: [ "@pinia/nuxt", // Example: Pinia state management // '@nuxtjs/tailwindcss', // Example: Tailwind CSS module ], // Runtime Config (Environment Variables) runtimeConfig: { // Private keys, only available on server-side apiSecret: process.env.NUXT_API_SECRET || "default_secret", // Read from .env // Public keys that are exposed to the client-side public: { apiBase: process.env.NUXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE || "/api", }, }, // App Metadata (Head, Transitions) app: { head: { charset: "utf-8", viewport: "width=device-width, initial-scale=1", title: "My Awesome Nuxt App", meta: [{ name: "description", content: "Site description" }], link: [{ rel: "icon", type: "image/x-icon", href: "/favicon.ico" }], }, pageTransition: { name: "page", mode: "out-in" }, // Example CSS transition layoutTransition: { name: "layout", mode: "out-in" }, }, // Vite specific config (if needed) // vite: { // css: { // preprocessorOptions: { // scss: { // additionalData: '@use "@/assets/_colors.scss" as *;' // } // } // } // }, // Nitro server config (if needed) // nitro: { // preset: 'vercel', // Example for Vercel deployment // } });

searchDocs.title: 说明​
searchDocs.content: 模块是 Nuxt 的核心扩展机制。它们可以封装可重用的功能，如集成 UI 库、添加分析、优化图片、集成 CMS 等。  安装: 通过 npm/yarn 安装社区或官方模块。注册: 在 nuxt.config.ts 的 modules 数组中添加模块名称或路径。配置: 许多模块允许通过 nuxt.config.ts 中的同名 key 或在 modules 数组中使用元组 ['module-name', { options }] 来传递配置选项。官方模块示例: @nuxt/content, @nuxt/image, @pinia/nuxt, @nuxtjs/tailwindcss.

searchDocs.title: 示例代码 (nuxt.config.ts 注册模块)​
searchDocs.content: export default defineNuxtConfig({ modules: [ // Simple registration "@pinia/nuxt", "@nuxt/image", // Requires installation: npm install -D @nuxt/image // Registration with options (example for a hypothetical auth module) // ['@nuxtjs/auth-next', { // strategies: { // local: { /* ... */ } // } // }], ], // Module specific configuration (some modules use this convention) // image: { // provider: 'ipx', // or 'cloudinary', 'imgix', etc. // screens: { /* ... */ } // }, // runtimeConfig can often be used by modules too // runtimeConfig: { // public: { // content: { // // Content module options accessible at runtime // } // } // } });

searchDocs.title: 说明​
searchDocs.content: Nuxt 提供了 useHead composable 来动态管理文档的 <head> 部分，对于 SEO 和社交分享至关重要。  响应式: useHead 接受响应式数据 (refs, computed properties)。SSR 支持: 在服务器端渲染期间，useHead 会收集元数据并将其注入到初始 HTML 的 <head> 中。使用位置: 可以在页面、布局或组件的 <script setup> 中使用。app.head (全局): 在 nuxt.config.ts 中设置全局默认值。页面/组件中的 useHead 会覆盖或合并这些默认值。

searchDocs.title: 示例代码​
searchDocs.content: <!-- pages/products/[id].vue --> <template> <div> <h1>{{ product?.title || "Loading..." }}</h1> <p>{{ product?.description }}</p> </div> </template> <script setup> const route = useRoute(); const productId = route.params.id; // Fetch product data const { data: product, error } = await useFetch(`/api/products/${productId}`); // Assuming API route exists if (error.value) { showError({ statusCode: 404, statusMessage: "Product not found" }); } // Set dynamic head metadata using useHead useHead({ title: () => `${product.value?.title || "Product"} | My Store`, // Reactive title meta: [ { name: "description", content: () => product.value?.description || "Check out this amazing product.", }, // Open Graph tags for social sharing { property: "og:title", content: () => `${product.value?.title || "Product"} | My Store`, }, { property: "og:description", content: () => product.value?.description }, { property: "og:image", content: () => product.value?.thumbnail }, // Assuming product has a thumbnail URL { property: "og:url", content: () => `https://mystore.com/products/${productId}`, }, { property: "og:type", content: "product" }, // Twitter card tags // { name: 'twitter:card', content: 'summary_large_image' }, ], // link: [ // { rel: 'canonical', href: () => `https://mystore.com/products/${productId}` } // ], // bodyAttrs: { // Example: adding class to body // class: 'product-page' // } }); </script>

searchDocs.title: 说明​
searchDocs.content: Nuxt 提供了处理错误的机制。  error.vue: 在项目根目录 (srcDir) 下创建 error.vue 文件来自定义全局错误页面。它会接收一个 error prop，包含错误信息 (statusCode, statusMessage, message, stack)。showError: 一个全局辅助函数，用于在客户端或服务器端触发错误页面显示。可以传入错误对象或状态码/消息。clearError: 一个全局辅助函数，用于清除当前错误并尝试重定向回正常页面（通常与 error.vue 中的“返回首页”按钮结合使用）。App Router Error Component (error.js): (Nuxt 3.x experimental/future) Nuxt is aligning with Next.js's App Router concepts, which include route segment error boundaries (error.js). This is less common in stable Nuxt 3 as of writing compared to the global error.vue.

searchDocs.title: 示例代码​
searchDocs.content: <!-- error.vue (in project root, alongside app.vue) --> <template> <NuxtLayout name="custom"> <!-- Optional: Use a specific layout --> <div style="text-align: center; padding: 50px;"> <h1>Error {{ error.statusCode }}</h1> <p> {{ error.statusMessage || error.message || "An unexpected error occurred." }} </p> <pre v-if="isDev && error.stack">{{ error.stack }}</pre> <button @click="handleErrorClear">Go back to Home</button> </div> </NuxtLayout> </template> <script setup> const props = defineProps({ error: Object, // Nuxt automatically passes the error object here }); const isDev = process.dev; // Use appropriate layout (optional) // definePageMeta({ // layout: 'error-layout' // If you have layouts/error-layout.vue // }); useHead({ title: `Error ${props.error.statusCode} | My Site`, meta: [{ name: "description", content: "Something went wrong." }], }); const handleErrorClear = () => { clearError({ redirect: "/" }); // Clear error and redirect to homepage }; </script> <style scoped> /* Add styles for your error page */ pre { white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word; text-align: left; background-color: #f3f3f3; padding: 10px; margin-top: 20px; max-height: 300px; overflow-y: auto; } </style>   Triggering an Error (Example in a page)​  // pages/test-error.vue <script setup> const trigger404 = () => { // Use statusCode and statusMessage for known errors like 404 showError({ statusCode: 404, statusMessage: "Page Not Found Custom Message", }); }; const trigger500 = () => { // For unexpected server/client errors, pass an Error object const err = new Error("Something broke!"); showError(err); // Or just statusCode: // showError({ statusCode: 500, statusMessage: 'Internal Server Error'}) }; </script> <template> <button @click="trigger404">Trigger 404</button> <button @click="trigger500">Trigger 500 Error</button> </template>

searchDocs.title: 1. 路由系统 (Routing)​
searchDocs.content: Next.js 提供了两种主要的路由系统：Pages Router 和 App Router。App Router 是较新的系统（自 Next.js 13 引入），推荐用于新项目，提供了更灵活的布局和组件模型。

searchDocs.title: 1.1 Pages Router (pages 目录)​
searchDocs.content: 说明​  基于文件的路由系统，位于 pages 目录下。文件和文件夹结构直接映射到 URL 路径。  pages/index.js -> /pages/about.js -> /aboutpages/posts/index.js -> /postspages/posts/[id].js -> /posts/:id (动态路由)pages/docs/[...slug].js -> /docs/* (捕获所有路由)pages/api/ -> API 路由（见后续章节）  示例代码​  // pages/about.js import React from 'react'; function AboutPage() { return <h1>About Us Page</h1>; } export default AboutPage; // pages/posts/[id].js import React from 'react'; import { useRouter } from 'next/router'; function PostDetailPage() { const router = useRouter(); const { id } = router.query; // Access dynamic route parameter 'id' return <h1>Post Detail Page for ID: {id}</h1>; } export default PostDetailPage; // pages/docs/[...slug].js import React from 'react'; import { useRouter } from 'next/router'; function DocsCatchAllPage() { const router = useRouter(); const { slug } = router.query; // slug will be an array of path segments return <h1>Docs Page: {slug ? slug.join('/') : 'Index'}</h1>; } export default DocsCatchAllPage;

searchDocs.title: 1.2 App Router (app 目录)​
searchDocs.content: 说明​  App Router 在 app 目录下工作，引入了基于 React Server Components 的新范式和文件约定。  文件夹定义路由段: app/dashboard/settings -> /dashboard/settingspage.js: 定义路由段的 UI，使其公开可访问。layout.js: 定义跨多个子路由段共享的 UI 布局。根布局 app/layout.js 是必需的。loading.js: 为路由段创建加载状态 UI (使用 React Suspense)。error.js: 为路由段创建错误边界 UI，捕获错误并显示回退界面。template.js: 类似于 layout.js，但在导航时会重新挂载，不保留 state。route.js: 定义 API 端点 (替代 Pages Router 的 API Routes)。动态路由段: app/products/[productId]/page.js -> /products/:productId捕获所有路由段: app/shop/[...slug]/page.js -> /shop/*可选捕获所有路由段: app/optional/[[...slug]]/page.js -> /optional/* 和 /optional  示例代码​  // app/layout.js (Required Root Layout) import React from 'react'; import './globals.css'; // Example global styles export const metadata = { // Metadata API (See Section 9) title: 'My Next.js App', description: 'Generated by create next app', }; export default function RootLayout({ children }) { return ( <html lang="en"> <body> <nav style={{ padding: '10px', borderBottom: '1px solid #ccc' }}> Root Navigation </nav> <main style={{ padding: '10px' }}> {children} {/* Page content renders here */} </main> </body> </html> ); } // app/dashboard/layout.js (Nested Layout) import React from 'react'; export default function DashboardLayout({ children }) { return ( <section style={{ display: 'flex' }}> <aside style={{ width: '200px', borderRight: '1px solid #eee', padding: '10px' }}> Dashboard Sidebar {/* Links specific to dashboard */} </aside> <div style={{ flexGrow: 1, padding: '10px' }}> {children} {/* Dashboard pages render here */} </div> </section> ); } // app/dashboard/settings/page.js import React from 'react'; export default function SettingsPage() { return <h1>Dashboard Settings</h1>; } // app/products/[productId]/page.js (Dynamic Route) import React from 'react'; // Access dynamic params via props export default function ProductDetailPage({ params }) { return <h1>Product Detail for ID: {params.productId}</h1>; } // app/dashboard/loading.js (Loading UI for dashboard segment) import React from 'react'; export default function DashboardLoading() { return <p>Loading dashboard section...</p>; } // app/dashboard/error.js (Error UI for dashboard segment) 'use client'; // Error components must be Client Components import React from 'react'; export default function DashboardError({ error, reset }) { useEffect(() => { // Log the error to an error reporting service console.error(error); }, [error]); return ( <div> <h2>Something went wrong in the dashboard!</h2> <p>{error.message}</p> <button onClick={ // Attempt to recover by trying to re-render the segment () => reset() } > Try again </button> </div> ); }

searchDocs.title: 2. 渲染策略 (Rendering Strategies)​
searchDocs.content: Next.js 提供了灵活的渲染方式，可在页面（或路由段）级别选择。

searchDocs.title: 2.1 服务器端渲染 (SSR - Server-Side Rendering)​
searchDocs.content: 说明​  页面 HTML 在每次请求时于服务器上生成。适用于需要最新数据且对 SEO 友好的页面。  Pages Router: 使用 getServerSideProps 函数。App Router: 默认情况下组件是 Server Components。使用动态函数 (如 headers(), cookies()) 或将 fetch 的 cache 选项设为 'no-store' 会触发动态渲染 (SSR)。  示例代码 (Pages Router - getServerSideProps)​  // pages/ssr-profile.js import React from "react"; function SsrProfilePage({ user, timestamp }) { return ( <div> <h1>Profile (SSR)</h1> <p>User: {user.name}</p> <p>Generated at: {new Date(timestamp).toLocaleTimeString()}</p> </div> ); } export async function getServerSideProps(context) { // context contains request-specific params, query, req, res etc. const res = await fetch("https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users/1"); const user = await res.json(); if (!user) { return { notFound: true }; // Return 404 if user not found } return { props: { // Passed to the page component as props user, timestamp: Date.now(), // Example: include generation time }, }; } export default SsrProfilePage;   示例代码 (App Router - Dynamic Rendering)​  // app/dynamic-data/page.js import { cookies } from "next/headers"; // Using a dynamic function forces SSR import React from "react"; async function getDynamicData() { // Fetch data without caching, forcing dynamic fetch on every request const res = await fetch("https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/todos/1", { cache: "no-store", }); if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch"); return res.json(); } export default async function DynamicDataPage() { const cookieStore = cookies(); // Accessing cookies also opts into dynamic rendering const theme = cookieStore.get("theme")?.value || "light"; const data = await getDynamicData(); return ( <div> <h1>Dynamically Rendered Page</h1> <p>Current Theme from Cookie: {theme}</p> <p>Fetched Todo Title: {data.title}</p> </div> ); } // This page will be server-rendered on each request. export const dynamic = "force-dynamic"; // Optional: Explicitly force dynamic rendering

searchDocs.title: 2.2 静态站点生成 (SSG - Static Site Generation)​
searchDocs.content: 说明​  页面 HTML 在构建时生成。非常适合性能和 SEO，适用于内容不经常变化的页面（博客、文档、营销页）。  Pages Router: 使用 getStaticProps 函数。结合 getStaticPaths 可为动态路由预渲染多个页面。App Router: 默认行为。如果 Server Component 不使用动态函数且其数据获取是静态的 (默认 fetch 缓存)，页面会在构建时静态渲染。使用 generateStaticParams 可为动态路由生成静态页面。  示例代码 (Pages Router - getStaticProps & getStaticPaths)​  // pages/posts-static/[id].js import React from "react"; function StaticPostPage({ post }) { if (!post) return <p>Post not found.</p>; return ( <div> <h1>{post.title} (Static)</h1> <p>{post.body}</p> </div> ); } // Fetch data for a specific post at build time export async function getStaticProps({ params }) { const res = await fetch( `https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/${params.id}` ); const post = await res.json(); if (!post.id) { // Handle cases where the post doesn't exist at build time return { notFound: true }; } return { props: { post } }; } // Specify which dynamic paths should be pre-rendered at build time export async function getStaticPaths() { const res = await fetch( "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts?_limit=10" ); const posts = await res.json(); const paths = posts.map((post) => ({ params: { id: post.id.toString() }, })); return { paths, // Prerender these paths fallback: "blocking", // 'blocking': SSR if not generated, then cache. false: 404. true: show fallback UI, generate in background. }; } export default StaticPostPage;   示例代码 (App Router - Static Rendering & generateStaticParams)​  // app/static-products/[productId]/page.js import React from "react"; // Data fetching defaults to static (cache: 'force-cache') async function getProduct(productId) { const res = await fetch(`https://dummyjson.com/products/${productId}`); if (!res.ok) return null; return res.json(); } // Page component is a Server Component, renders statically by default export default async function StaticProductPage({ params }) { const product = await getProduct(params.productId); if (!product) return <div>Product not found!</div>; return ( <div> <h1>{product.title} (Static)</h1> <p>{product.description}</p> <p>Price: ${product.price}</p> </div> ); } // Equivalent to getStaticPaths: Generate static params at build time export async function generateStaticParams() { const res = await fetch("https://dummyjson.com/products?limit=5&select=id"); const { products } = await res.json(); return products.map((product) => ({ productId: product.id.toString(), // Param name must match folder name [productId] })); } // This route segment will be statically generated for products 1 through 5 at build time. // Other product IDs might be generated on demand if not found (depending on config/fallback behavior, though App Router's fallback is different).

searchDocs.title: 2.3 增量静态再生 (ISR - Incremental Static Regeneration)​
searchDocs.content: 说明​  允许在页面构建后，按设定的时间间隔重新生成静态页面，而无需完全重新构建站点。结合了 SSG 的性能和 SSR 的数据新鲜度。  Pages Router: 在 getStaticProps 返回对象中设置 revalidate 属性（秒数）。App Router: 在 fetch 调用中设置 next.revalidate 选项，或在页面/布局级别导出 revalidate 常量。  示例代码 (Pages Router)​  // pages/isr-time.js import React from "react"; function IsrTimePage({ time }) { return <h1>ISR Time: {new Date(time).toLocaleTimeString()}</h1>; } export async function getStaticProps() { // Fetch data or just get current time const time = Date.now(); return { props: { time }, revalidate: 10, // Re-generate the page at most once every 10 seconds }; } export default IsrTimePage;   示例代码 (App Router)​  // app/isr-example/page.js import React from "react"; async function getRevalidatedData() { // Fetch data with revalidation interval const res = await fetch("https://worldtimeapi.org/api/ip", { next: { revalidate: 5 }, // Revalidate every 5 seconds }); if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch time"); return res.json(); } // Or export revalidate constant at page level // export const revalidate = 5; export default async function IsrExamplePage() { const data = await getRevalidatedData(); return ( <div> <h1>ISR Example (App Router)</h1> <p> Current Time (approx): {new Date(data.datetime).toLocaleTimeString()} </p> <p>Timezone: {data.timezone}</p> <p>(This page revalidates every 5 seconds)</p> </div> ); }

searchDocs.title: 2.4 客户端渲染 (CSR - Client-Side Rendering)​
searchDocs.content: 说明​  内容在浏览器中使用 JavaScript 渲染。适用于需要高度交互、个性化且对初始加载 SEO 要求不高的部分（如用户仪表盘）。  Pages Router: 页面不使用 getServerSideProps 或 getStaticProps。通常在 useEffect Hook 中获取数据。App Router: 使用 'use client' 指令将组件标记为 Client Component。Client Components 可以在浏览器中运行，使用 Hooks、事件监听器等。  示例代码 (App Router - Client Component)​  // app/client-dashboard/page.js "use client"; // Mark this component and its imports as Client Components import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react"; export default function ClientDashboardPage() { const [data, setData] = useState(null); const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true); const [error, setError] = useState(null); useEffect(() => { setIsLoading(true); fetch("/api/dashboard-metrics") // Fetch data client-side from an API route .then((res) => { if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Network response was not ok"); return res.json(); }) .then((result) => { setData(result); setIsLoading(false); }) .catch((err) => { setError(err.message); setIsLoading(false); }); }, []); // Empty dependency array ensures this runs once on mount if (isLoading) return <p>Loading dashboard metrics...</p>; if (error) return <p>Error loading metrics: {error}</p>; if (!data) return <p>No metrics found.</p>; return ( <div> <h1>Client-Side Rendered Dashboard</h1> <p>Active Users: {data.activeUsers}</p> <p>Revenue: ${data.revenue}</p> {/* More interactive charts/elements */} </div> ); } // Assume you have an API route at app/api/dashboard-metrics/route.js (or pages/api/)

searchDocs.title: 3. App Router: Server Components vs. Client Components​
说明​
searchDocs.content: App Router 引入了 React Server Components (RSC) 作为核心。  Server Components (默认): 在服务器上渲染。可以直接访问后端资源（数据库、文件系统）、执行 async/await 获取数据。不能使用 Hooks (useState, useEffect 等) 或浏览器 API (window, document)。减少发送到客户端的 JavaScript 包大小。适合静态内容展示、数据获取。 Client Components ('use client' 指令): 在客户端渲染（初始 HTML 可由服务器预渲染）。可以使用 Hooks、状态、生命周期、事件监听器、浏览器 API。需要交互性或浏览器特定功能的组件必须是 Client Components。在文件顶部添加 'use client' 指令。一旦标记，其导入的所有子组件（除非是 Server Component 作为 children prop 传入）也会被视为 Client Components。  最佳实践: 尽量将组件保持为 Server Components，仅在需要客户端交互或浏览器 API 时使用 'use client'，并将 Client Components 放在组件树的叶子节点附近。

searchDocs.title: 示例代码 (混合使用)​
searchDocs.content: // app/server-client-mix/page.js (Server Component by default) import React from 'react'; import InteractiveButton from './InteractiveButton'; // Import Client Component async function getServerTime() { await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 50)); // Simulate delay return new Date().toLocaleTimeString(); } export default async function ServerClientMixPage() { const time = await getServerTime(); console.log("Rendering ServerClientMixPage on server..."); return ( <div> <h1>Server and Client Component Mix</h1> <p>This part is rendered on the server.</p> <p>Server Time: {time}</p> {/* Render Client Component within Server Component */} <InteractiveButton initialCount={5}> {/* You can pass Server Components as children to Client Components */} <p>This is a child from the Server Component!</p> </InteractiveButton> {/* Cannot use hooks or event handlers directly here */} {/* <button onClick={() => alert('hi')}>Invalid in Server Component</button> */} </div> ); } // app/server-client-mix/InteractiveButton.jsx 'use client'; // Mark as Client Component import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; export default function InteractiveButton({ initialCount = 0, children }) { const [count, setCount] = useState(initialCount); useEffect(() => { console.log("InteractiveButton mounted on client."); // Can use browser APIs here // window.alert("Client component ready!") // (Example, maybe annoying) }, []); const handleClick = () => { setCount(prev => prev + 1); console.log("Button clicked on client!"); }; console.log("Rendering InteractiveButton on client..."); return ( <div style={{ border: '1px solid blue', padding: '10px', marginTop: '10px' }}> <p>This is the Client Component area.</p> <button onClick={handleClick}> Clicked {count} times </button> {/* Render children passed from Server Component */} <div style={{ marginTop: '5px', fontStyle: 'italic' }}> Children from server: {children} </div> </div> ); }

searchDocs.title: 4.1 Pages Router​
searchDocs.content: getServerSideProps: 请求时获取 (SSR)。getStaticProps: 构建时获取 (SSG/ISR)。getStaticPaths: 指定动态路由的预渲染路径 (SSG/ISR)。客户端获取: 在 useEffect 中使用 fetch 或库 (SWR, TanStack Query)。  (示例见上方渲染策略部分)

searchDocs.title: 4.2 App Router​
searchDocs.content: Server Components (直接 fetch): 在 Server Components 中直接使用 async/await 和 fetch。 自动缓存: Next.js 扩展了 fetch API，默认情况下会积极缓存请求 (cache: 'force-cache')，行为类似 getStaticProps。控制缓存: fetch(url, { cache: 'no-store' }): 不缓存，每次请求都重新获取（SSR 行为）。fetch(url, { next: { revalidate: seconds } }): 缓存数据，但设定重新验证时间（ISR 行为）。 generateStaticParams: 构建时为动态路由生成参数 (类似 getStaticPaths)。Route Handlers (route.js): 创建 API 端点，供客户端组件 fetch 调用。Server Actions: (稳定) 允许从 Client Components 安全地调用在服务器上定义的异步函数。极大地简化了表单提交和数据变更逻辑，无需手动创建 API 端点。  示例代码 (App Router - fetch 缓存控制)​  // app/fetch-cache-demo/page.js (Server Component) import React from "react"; async function getCachedData() { console.log("Fetching cached data (should happen rarely/at build)..."); const res = await fetch("https://dummyjson.com/products/2", { cache: "force-cache", }); // Default return res.json(); } async function getNoStoreData() { console.log("Fetching no-store data (should happen on every request)..."); const res = await fetch("https://dummyjson.com/products/3", { cache: "no-store", }); return res.json(); } async function getRevalidatedData() { console.log("Fetching revalidated data (should happen every 10s)..."); const res = await fetch("https://dummyjson.com/products/4", { next: { revalidate: 10 }, }); return res.json(); } export default async function FetchCacheDemoPage() { const cached = await getCachedData(); const noStore = await getNoStoreData(); const revalidated = await getRevalidatedData(); return ( <div> <h1>Fetch Cache Demo</h1> <h2>Cached (Default): {cached.title}</h2> <h2>No Store (Dynamic): {noStore.title}</h2> <h2>Revalidated (ISR, 10s): {revalidated.title}</h2> </div> ); }   示例代码 (App Router - Server Action)​  // app/server-actions-demo/actions.js 'use server'; // Mark functions in this file as Server Actions import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache'; // Example: Simulate adding an item to a list (in a real app, interact with DB) let items = ['Apple', 'Banana']; export async function addItem(formData) { const newItem = formData.get('item'); // Get data from form if (newItem && typeof newItem === 'string' && newItem.trim() !== '') { console.log("Server Action: Adding item", newItem); await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500)); // Simulate async items.push(newItem.trim()); revalidatePath('/server-actions-demo'); // Revalidate the page to show updated list return { success: true, message: `${newItem} added!` }; } else { return { success: false, message: 'Item cannot be empty.' }; } } export async function getItems() { console.log("Server Action: Getting items"); return items; } // app/server-actions-demo/ItemForm.jsx 'use client'; // This component handles the form interaction import React, { useState, useTransition } from 'react'; import { addItem } from './actions'; // Import the Server Action export default function ItemForm() { const [message, setMessage] = useState(''); const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition(); // Handle pending state const handleSubmit = async (event) => { event.preventDefault(); const formData = new FormData(event.currentTarget); startTransition(async () => { const result = await addItem(formData); // Call the server action directly setMessage(result.message); if (result.success) { event.target.reset(); // Reset form on success } }); }; return ( <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}> <input type="text" name="item" placeholder="New Item" disabled={isPending} required /> <button type="submit" disabled={isPending}> {isPending ? 'Adding...' : 'Add Item'} </button> {message && <p>{message}</p>} </form> ); } // app/server-actions-demo/page.js (Server Component to display items) import React from 'react'; import ItemForm from './ItemForm'; import { getItems } from './actions'; // Import action to get data export default async function ServerActionsPage() { const currentItems = await getItems(); // Call action on server to get initial data return ( <div> <h1>Server Actions Demo</h1> <h2>Add Item</h2> <ItemForm /> <h2>Current Items</h2> <ul> {currentItems.map((item, index) => <li key={index}>{item}</li>)} </ul> {currentItems.length === 0 && <p>No items yet.</p>} </div> ); }

searchDocs.title: 5.1 <Link> Component (next/link)​
searchDocs.content: 说明​  用于在 Next.js 应用的不同页面之间进行客户端导航。它会自动预取链接页面的代码（在视口内时），实现快速、平滑的页面过渡，无需整页刷新。适用于 Pages Router 和 App Router。  示例代码​  import React from "react"; import Link from "next/link"; function NavigationMenu() { const postId = 5; return ( <nav> <ul style={{ listStyle: "none", display: "flex", gap: "15px" }}> <li> <Link href="/">Home</Link> </li> <li> <Link href="/about">About</Link> </li> {/* Dynamic route link */} <li> <Link href={`/posts-static/${postId}`}>Post {postId} (Static)</Link> </li> {/* Link within App Router */} <li> <Link href="/dashboard/settings">Dashboard Settings</Link> </li> {/* Disable prefetching */} <li> <Link href="/contact" prefetch={false}> Contact (No Prefetch) </Link> </li> {/* Add attributes like className */} <li> <Link href="/ssr-profile" className="nav-link"> SSR Profile </Link> </li> </ul> </nav> ); } export default NavigationMenu;

searchDocs.title: 5.2 useRouter Hook (Pages Router - next/router)​
searchDocs.content: 说明​  用于在函数组件中以编程方式进行导航（如表单提交后跳转）或访问路由信息（路径名、查询参数）。  示例代码 (Pages Router)​  // components/LoginButton.jsx (Pages Router example) import React from "react"; import { useRouter } from "next/router"; function LoginButton() { const router = useRouter(); const handleLogin = () => { // Simulate login... console.log("Login successful, redirecting..."); // Programmatic navigation router.push("/dashboard"); // Redirect to dashboard page // router.replace('/dashboard'); // Similar, but replaces history entry }; return <button onClick={handleLogin}>Login and Go to Dashboard</button>; } export default LoginButton;

searchDocs.title: 5.3 Navigation Hooks (App Router - next/navigation)​
searchDocs.content: 说明​  App Router 提供了专门的 Hooks 来处理导航和路由状态。  useRouter(): 提供 push, replace, refresh, back, forward 方法。refresh() 可在不丢失客户端状态的情况下刷新当前路由，重新获取服务器数据并渲染 Server Components。usePathname(): 返回当前 URL 的路径名字符串。useSearchParams(): 返回当前 URL 查询参数的只读 URLSearchParams 接口。useParams(): 返回包含当前路由动态参数的对象。  示例代码 (App Router)​  // app/products/ProductSearch.jsx "use client"; import React, { useState } from "react"; import { useRouter, usePathname, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation"; export default function ProductSearch() { const router = useRouter(); const pathname = usePathname(); // e.g., "/products" const searchParams = useSearchParams(); // Readonly access to query params const currentQuery = searchParams.get("q"); const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState(currentQuery || ""); const handleSearch = (event) => { event.preventDefault(); const params = new URLSearchParams(searchParams); // Create mutable copy if (searchTerm) { params.set("q", searchTerm); } else { params.delete("q"); } // Navigate with new query params router.push(`${pathname}?${params.toString()}`); }; const refreshData = () => { console.log("Refreshing server data for current route..."); router.refresh(); // Re-fetches data for the current route }; return ( <div> <form onSubmit={handleSearch}> <input type="text" placeholder="Search products..." value={searchTerm} onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)} /> <button type="submit">Search</button> </form> <button onClick={refreshData} style={{ marginLeft: "10px" }}> Refresh Data </button> <p>Current Path: {pathname}</p> <p>Current Search: {currentQuery || "None"}</p> </div> ); }

searchDocs.title: 说明​
searchDocs.content: 允许你在 Next.js 应用内部创建 API 端点，处理来自客户端或其他服务的请求。  Pages Router: 在 pages/api 目录下创建文件。导出一个默认函数，该函数接收 req (NextApiRequest) 和 res (NextApiResponse) 对象。App Router: 在 app 目录下创建 route.js 文件。导出对应 HTTP 方法的大写命名函数（GET, POST, PUT, DELETE 等），这些函数接收 request (Request) 对象，并应返回 Response 或 NextResponse 对象。NextResponse 是 Response 的扩展，提供了一些便利方法（如 json()）。

searchDocs.title: 示例代码 (Pages Router - API Route)​
searchDocs.content: // pages/api/hello.js import type { NextApiRequest, NextApiResponse } from "next"; type ResponseData = { message: string, }; export default function handler( req: NextApiRequest, res: NextApiResponse<ResponseData> ) { if (req.method === "GET") { const name = req.query.name || "World"; res.status(200).json({ message: `Hello, ${name}!` }); } else { res.setHeader("Allow", ["GET"]); res.status(405).end(`Method ${req.method} Not Allowed`); } }

searchDocs.title: 示例代码 (App Router - Route Handler)​
searchDocs.content: // app/api/items/route.js import { NextResponse } from "next/server"; let items = [{ id: 1, name: "Default Item" }]; // In-memory store (for demo) // Handle GET requests export async function GET(request: Request) { // You can access query params from the request URL const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url); const limit = searchParams.get("limit"); let responseItems = items; if (limit && !isNaN(parseInt(limit))) { responseItems = items.slice(0, parseInt(limit)); } console.log("API GET /api/items called"); return NextResponse.json(responseItems); } // Handle POST requests export async function POST(request: Request) { try { const body = await request.json(); // Parse JSON body if (!body.name) { return NextResponse.json( { error: "Item name is required" }, { status: 400 } ); } const newItem = { id: Date.now(), name: body.name }; items.push(newItem); console.log("API POST /api/items called, added:", newItem); return NextResponse.json(newItem, { status: 201 }); // Return created item with 201 status } catch (error) { return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid JSON body" }, { status: 400 }); } }

searchDocs.title: 7.1 静态文件伺服 (public 目录)​
searchDocs.content: 说明​  public 目录用于存放静态资源（图片、字体、robots.txt、favicon.ico 等）。此目录下的文件会从应用的根 URL (/) 提供服务。例如 public/logo.png 可通过 /logo.png 访问。  示例代码​  // components/Header.jsx import React from "react"; function Header() { return ( <header> {/* Accessing image from public directory */} <img src="/images/logo.svg" alt="My Company Logo" height={40} /> <h1>My Website</h1> </header> ); } // Assumes public/images/logo.svg exists export default Header;

searchDocs.title: 7.2 图片组件 (next/image)​
searchDocs.content: 说明​  next/image 组件是 HTML <img> 标签的优化版本。它提供：  自动尺寸优化: 根据设备提供适当大小的图片。视觉稳定性: 防止布局偏移 (CLS)。按需加载: 图片默认懒加载 (进入视口时加载)。格式优化: 自动提供 WebP 等现代格式（如果浏览器支持）。必须提供 width 和 height（对于本地图片会自动推断，对于远程图片必须手动指定），或使用 fill 属性。远程图片需要在 next.config.js 中配置允许的域名。  示例代码​  // components/OptimizedImage.jsx import React from "react"; import Image from "next/image"; // Import local image (width/height inferred) import localHeroImage from "../public/images/hero.jpg"; function OptimizedImage() { return ( <div> <h2>Optimized Images with next/image</h2> {/* Local Image */} <Image src={localHeroImage} alt="Beautiful landscape" placeholder="blur" // Optional: Show low-res blurred placeholder while loading style={{ maxWidth: "100%", height: "auto" }} // Make it responsive /> <hr /> {/* Remote Image */} <Image src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1..." // Replace with actual URL alt="Remote image description" width={500} // Required for remote images height={300} // Required for remote images priority // Optional: Preload image if it's LCP (Largest Contentful Paint) /> <hr /> {/* Fill Example */} <div style={{ position: "relative", width: "100%", height: "200px" }}> <Image src="/images/background.png" // From public folder alt="Background texture" fill // Fills the parent container style={{ objectFit: "cover" }} // Optional: control how image fits /> <h3 style={{ position: "relative", color: "white", zIndex: 1, padding: "10px", }} > Text over fill image </h3> </div> </div> ); } export default OptimizedImage; // next.config.js (Required for remote image domains) // /** @type {import('next').NextConfig} */ // const nextConfig = { // images: { // remotePatterns: [ // { // protocol: 'https', // hostname: 'images.unsplash.com', // // port: '', // Optional port // // pathname: '/account123/**', // Optional path prefix // }, // ], // }, // }; // module.exports = nextConfig;

searchDocs.title: 8. 样式 (Styling)​
searchDocs.content: Next.js 支持多种样式方案。

searchDocs.title: 8.1 全局样式 (Global CSS)​
searchDocs.content: 说明​  在根布局 (app/layout.js) 或 pages/_app.js 中导入 CSS 文件以应用全局样式。只应在这里导入全局样式表。  示例代码​  // app/layout.js (App Router) import "../styles/globals.css"; // Import global styles export default function RootLayout({ children }) { /* ... */ } // styles/globals.css // body { // margin: 0; // font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, Fira Sans, Droid Sans, Helvetica Neue, sans-serif; // line-height: 1.6; // } // * { box-sizing: border-box; }

searchDocs.title: 8.2 CSS Modules​
searchDocs.content: 说明​  通过将 CSS 文件命名为 [name].module.css 来实现组件级别的作用域。导入后，类名会自动生成唯一的哈希值，避免样式冲突。  示例代码​  // components/Button/Button.module.css // .button { // background-color: dodgerblue; // color: white; // padding: 10px 15px; // border: none; // border-radius: 4px; // cursor: pointer; // transition: background-color 0.2s ease; // } // .button:hover { // background-color: royalblue; // } // .error { // background-color: tomato; // } // .error:hover { // background-color: crimson; // } // components/Button/Button.jsx import React from "react"; import styles from "./Button.module.css"; // Import CSS Module function Button({ children, variant }) { // Conditionally apply classes const buttonClass = `${styles.button} ${ variant === "error" ? styles.error : "" }`; return <button className={buttonClass}>{children}</button>; } export default Button;

searchDocs.title: 8.3 Tailwind CSS​
searchDocs.content: 说明​  Next.js 对流行的工具类优先 CSS 框架 Tailwind CSS 提供了一流的支持。通过 PostCSS 轻松集成。  配置与使用 (简要)​  安装: npm install -D tailwindcss postcss autoprefixer初始化: npx tailwindcss init -p配置 tailwind.config.js 中的 content 路径。在 styles/globals.css 中导入 Tailwind 指令 (@tailwind base; @tailwind components; @tailwind utilities;)。在组件中使用 Tailwind 类。  示例代码​  // components/Alert.jsx import React from "react"; function Alert({ message, type = "info" }) { const baseStyle = "border px-4 py-3 rounded relative"; const typeStyles = { info: "bg-blue-100 border-blue-400 text-blue-700", success: "bg-green-100 border-green-400 text-green-700", error: "bg-red-100 border-red-400 text-red-700", }; return ( <div className={`${baseStyle} ${typeStyles[type]}`} role="alert"> <span className="block sm:inline">{message}</span> </div> ); } export default Alert;

searchDocs.title: 8.4 Sass/SCSS​
searchDocs.content: 说明​  Next.js 内置 Sass 支持。只需安装 sass 包即可使用 .scss 或 .sass 文件，包括 CSS Modules (.module.scss)。  示例代码​  安装: npm install -D sass 使用: // styles/variables.module.scss // $primary-color: #8a2be2; // BlueViolet // .highlight { // color: $primary-color; // font-weight: bold; // border-bottom: 2px solid $primary-color; // } // components/HighlightText.jsx import React from "react"; import styles from "../styles/variables.module.scss"; function HighlightText({ children }) { return <span className={styles.highlight}>{children}</span>; } export default HighlightText;

searchDocs.title: 9.1 Pages Router (next/head)​
searchDocs.content: 说明​  使用 next/head 组件向当前页面的 <head> 标签添加元素 (title, meta, link 等)。  示例代码​  // pages/seo-example.js import React from "react"; import Head from "next/head"; function SeoExamplePage() { return ( <div> <Head> <title>SEO Example Page | My Site</title> <meta name="description" content="Learn about SEO in Next.js Pages Router." /> <meta property="og:title" content="SEO Example Page" /> <meta property="og:description" content="A demonstration of next/head." /> <meta property="og:image" content="/images/og-image.jpg" /> <link rel="canonical" href="https://example.com/seo-example" /> {/* Add more meta tags as needed */} </Head> <main> <h1>Page focused on SEO</h1> <p>Content goes here...</p> </main> </div> ); } export default SeoExamplePage;

searchDocs.title: 9.2 App Router (Metadata API)​
searchDocs.content: 说明​  App Router 引入了新的 Metadata API，允许通过导出 metadata 对象或 generateMetadata 函数来定义和管理元数据，支持静态和动态生成，并能继承父级布局的元数据。  静态元数据: 在 layout.js 或 page.js 中导出 metadata 对象。动态元数据: 导出异步函数 generateMetadata({ params, searchParams }, parent)，可根据路由参数或获取的数据生成元数据，并可访问父级解析后的元数据 (parent)。  示例代码​  // app/blog/[slug]/page.js import React from "react"; // Assume getPostBySlug fetches post data including title, description etc. async function getPostBySlug(slug) { // Replace with your actual data fetching logic if (slug === "my-first-post") { return { title: "My First Blog Post", description: "This is the summary...", content: "...", }; } return null; } // Dynamic Metadata Generation export async function generateMetadata({ params, searchParams }, parent) { const slug = params.slug; const post = await getPostBySlug(slug); if (!post) { return { title: "Post Not Found" }; // Basic title if not found } // Optionally access resolved metadata from parent layouts const previousKeywords = (await parent).keywords || []; return { title: `${post.title} | My Blog`, description: post.description, keywords: ["blog", post.title, ...previousKeywords], // Combine keywords openGraph: { title: post.title, description: post.description, // images: [`/images/blog/${slug}.jpg`], // Example OG image }, //alternates: { // Example for canonical URL // canonical: `/blog/${slug}`, //} }; } export default async function BlogPostPage({ params }) { const post = await getPostBySlug(params.slug); if (!post) return <div>Post not found!</div>; return ( <article> <h1>{post.title}</h1> <p>{post.content}</p> </article> ); } // You can also define static metadata in layout.js that applies to all child routes // app/blog/layout.js // export const metadata = { // title: { // template: '%s | My Blog', // Title template for child pages // default: 'My Blog', // Default title if child doesn't provide one // }, // description: 'Welcome to my tech blog.', // keywords: ['technology', 'programming', 'web development'], // }; // export default function BlogLayout({ children }) { /* ... layout UI ... */ }

searchDocs.title: 10. 环境变量 (Environment Variables)​
searchDocs.content: 说明​  Next.js 支持通过 .env 系列文件加载环境变量。  优先级（从高到低）: .env.development.local, .env.production.local, .env.test.local, .env.local, .env.development, .env.production, .env.test, .env。.local 文件应加入 .gitignore。服务器端变量: 默认情况下，所有变量仅在 Node.js 环境（服务器端）可用。浏览器端变量: 必须以 NEXT_PUBLIC_ 前缀命名才能暴露给浏览器。  示例代码​  # .env.local (DO NOT COMMIT) DATABASE_PASSWORD=supersecret STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=sk_test_123... # .env (Can be committed) NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://api.example.com NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_ID=G-ABC123XYZ   // Accessing env variables // In Server Components, Route Handlers, getServerSideProps, getStaticProps: function ExampleServerComponent() { // Both server-only and public variables are accessible console.log("Server DB Password:", process.env.DATABASE_PASSWORD); // OK console.log("Server Stripe Key:", process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY); // OK console.log("Server Public API URL:", process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL); // OK return <div>Check server console logs.</div>; } // In Client Components (or useEffect in Pages Router): // 'use client'; // Mark as Client Component if using App Router import React, { useEffect } from "react"; function ExampleClientComponent() { useEffect(() => { // ONLY variables prefixed with NEXT_PUBLIC_ are accessible! // console.log('Client DB Password:', process.env.DATABASE_PASSWORD); // undefined // console.log('Client Stripe Key:', process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY); // undefined console.log("Client Public API URL:", process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL); // OK console.log("Client GA ID:", process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_ID); // OK }, []); return <div>Check browser console logs for PUBLIC env vars.</div>; }

searchDocs.title: 11. Middleware (middleware.js / middleware.ts)​
searchDocs.content: 说明​  Middleware 允许你在请求完成之前运行代码，基于请求修改响应（重写 URL、重定向、添加/修改请求/响应头）或直接响应。它在 Edge Runtime 上运行，速度快但 API 受限。  在项目的根目录或 src/ 目录下创建 middleware.js (或 .ts) 文件。使用 config 对象中的 matcher 属性指定 Middleware 应用的路径。  示例代码​  // middleware.ts (at root or src/) import { NextResponse } from "next/server"; import type { NextRequest } from "next/server"; export function middleware(request: NextRequest) { const { pathname } = request.nextUrl; const requestHeaders = new Headers(request.headers); // Clone headers // Example 1: Basic Authentication for staging environment const basicAuth = request.headers.get("authorization"); const url = request.nextUrl; if (url.hostname.includes("staging.myapp.com")) { // Apply only on staging if (basicAuth) { const authValue = basicAuth.split(" ")[1]; const [user, pwd] = atob(authValue).split(":"); // Decode Base64 const expectedUser = process.env.BASIC_AUTH_USER; const expectedPwd = process.env.BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD; if (user === expectedUser && pwd === expectedPwd) { return NextResponse.next(); // Authorized } } url.pathname = "/api/auth-required"; // Redirect to an auth required page/API return NextResponse.rewrite(url); // Or return a 401 response directly // return new Response('Auth required', { status: 401, headers: { 'WWW-Authenticate': 'Basic realm="Secure Area"' }}); } // Example 2: Add a custom header requestHeaders.set("x-pathname", pathname); console.log(`Middleware: Processing ${pathname}`); // Example 3: Redirect based on geo location (example header) const country = request.geo?.country?.toLowerCase() || "us"; if (pathname === "/" && country === "ca") { console.log("Middleware: Redirecting CA user to /ca"); return NextResponse.redirect(new URL("/ca", request.url)); } // Continue processing the request with potentially modified headers return NextResponse.next({ request: { headers: requestHeaders, }, }); } // Define which paths this middleware should run on export const config = { matcher: [ /* * Match all request paths except for the ones starting with: * - api (API routes) * - _next/static (static files) * - _next/image (image optimization files) * - favicon.ico (favicon file) * - Health check paths etc. */ "/((?!api|_next/static|_next/image|favicon.ico|healthz).*)", // Or specific paths: // '/dashboard/:path*', // '/' ], }; // You might need a dummy API route for the auth redirect example: // app/api/auth-required/route.js // export async function GET() { // return new Response('Authentication Required', { status: 401, headers: { 'WWW-Authenticate': 'Basic realm="Secure Area"' }}); // }
