六、 Node.js Web 开发基础 (以 Express 为例)​
searchDocs.content: 虽然 Node.js 提供了 http 模块，但直接使用它来构建复杂的 Web 应用比较繁琐。通常我们会使用框架来简化开发。Express 是目前最流行、最成熟的 Node.js Web 框架之一。

searchDocs.title: 1. Express 简介​
searchDocs.content: 说明： 一个基于 Node.js http 模块构建的、简洁、灵活的 Web 应用框架。它提供了一系列强大的特性，用于快速创建 Web 和 API 服务，如路由、中间件、模板引擎集成等。核心概念： 路由 (Routing): 定义应用程序如何响应客户端对特定端点（URI）和特定 HTTP 方法（GET, POST 等）的请求。中间件 (Middleware): 本质上是一个函数，可以访问请求对象 (req)、响应对象 (res) 和应用程序请求-响应周期中的下一个中间件函数 (next)。中间件可以： 执行任何代码。修改请求和响应对象。结束请求-响应周期。调用下一个中间件。常用于日志记录、身份验证、数据解析、错误处理等。 请求对象 (req): Express 对 Node.js 原生 http.IncomingMessage 对象的增强，添加了 req.params, req.query, req.body, req.ip, req.path 等有用属性。响应对象 (res): Express 对 Node.js 原生 http.ServerResponse 对象的增强，提供了 res.send(), res.json(), res.status(), res.render(), res.redirect() 等便捷方法。

searchDocs.title: 2. 基本使用​
searchDocs.content: 安装： npm install express 示例：一个简单的 Express 应用 const express = require("express"); const path = require("path"); const app = express(); // 创建 Express 应用实例 const port = 3002; // --- 中间件 --- // 1. 应用级中间件 (每次请求都会执行) app.use((req, res, next) => { console.log(`[${new Date().toISOString()}] ${req.method} ${req.url}`); next(); // 调用 next() 将控制权传递给下一个中间件或路由处理器 }); // 2. 内置中间件 - 解析 JSON 请求体 app.use(express.json()); // for parsing application/json // 3. 内置中间件 - 解析 URL 编码请求体 app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true })); // for parsing application/x-www-form-urlencoded // 4. 内置中间件 - 托管静态文件 (如 HTML, CSS, JS, 图片) app.use(express.static(path.join(__dirname, "public"))); // 将 public 目录设为静态资源根目录 // --- 路由 --- // GET 请求根路径 app.get("/", (req, res) => { // res.send('<h1>Hello World from Express!</h1>'); // 发送 HTML // 提供 public/index.html res.sendFile(path.join(__dirname, "public", "index.html")); }); // GET 请求 /about app.get("/about", (req, res) => { res.send("This is the About page."); }); // GET 请求带路由参数 /users/:userId app.get("/users/:userId", (req, res) => { const userId = req.params.userId; // 获取路由参数 res.send(`User Profile for User ID: ${userId}`); }); // GET 请求带查询参数 /search?q=keyword app.get("/search", (req, res) => { const query = req.query.q; // 获取查询参数 if (!query) { return res.status(400).send('Missing search query parameter "q"'); } res.send(`Searching for: ${query}`); }); // POST 请求 /api/data app.post("/api/data", (req, res) => { const requestData = req.body; // 获取 JSON 或 URL 编码的请求体 (需要 express.json() 或 express.urlencoded() 中间件) console.log("Received POST data:", requestData); if (!requestData || Object.keys(requestData).length === 0) { return res .status(400) .json({ error: "Request body is empty or invalid" }); } res .status(201) .json({ message: "Data received successfully", data: requestData }); }); // --- 错误处理中间件 --- // (通常放在所有路由和中间件之后) // 它有四个参数 (err, req, res, next) app.use((err, req, res, next) => { console.error("Unhandled Error:", err.stack); // 记录错误堆栈 res.status(500).send("Something broke!"); }); // 404 处理 (如果没有任何路由匹配) app.use((req, res, next) => { res.status(404).send("Sorry, can't find that!"); }); // --- 启动服务器 --- app.listen(port, () => { console.log(`Express server listening at http://localhost:${port}`); }); 需要创建一个 public 目录并在其中放入一个 index.html 文件来测试静态文件服务。

searchDocs.title: 七、 Node.js 错误处理​
searchDocs.content: 健壮的错误处理对于构建可靠的 Node.js 应用至关重要。

searchDocs.title: 1. 同步错误处理 (try...catch)​
searchDocs.content: 说明： 对于同步代码中可能抛出的异常，使用标准的 try...catch 块来捕获。 示例： function parseJsonSync(jsonString) { try { const data = JSON.parse(jsonString); console.log("JSON parsed successfully:", data); return data; } catch (error) { // 捕获 JSON.parse 可能抛出的 SyntaxError console.error("Failed to parse JSON:", error.message); // 返回 null 或抛出自定义错误 return null; } } parseJsonSync('{"name": "Node.js"}'); // Success parseJsonSync('{"invalid json"'); // Error logged

searchDocs.title: 2. 异步错误处理​
searchDocs.content: 错误优先回调: 回调函数的第一个参数用于传递错误对象。在使用回调风格的 API 时，必须检查第一个参数。 fs.readFile("nonexistent.txt", (err, data) => { if (err) { // 必须检查 err console.error("readFile error:", err); return; // 停止后续处理 } // 处理 data }); Promises (.catch()): 使用 Promise 链时，可以在链的末尾添加 .catch() 来捕获链中任何一个环节产生的 rejection。 fs.promises .readFile("file.txt") .then((data) => processData(data)) // processData 也可能返回 Promise 或抛错 .then((result) => saveResult(result)) .catch((err) => { // 捕获 readFile, processData, saveResult 中的错误 console.error("Promise chain error:", err); }); Async/Await (try...catch): 在 async 函数中，使用 try...catch 来包围 await 表达式，捕获其等待的 Promise 被 reject 时抛出的错误。 async function processFile() { try { const data = await fs.promises.readFile("file.txt"); const result = await processData(data); // await 会解包 Promise 或捕获同步错误 await saveResult(result); console.log("Process completed."); } catch (err) { // 捕获任何 await 失败或 try 块中的同步错误 console.error("Async function error:", err); } } EventEmitter ('error' 事件): 对于继承自 EventEmitter 的对象（如流、服务器），必须监听 'error' 事件。如果触发了 'error' 事件但没有监听器，Node.js 进程通常会崩溃。 const readable = fs.createReadStream("nonexistent.txt"); readable.on("error", (err) => { // 必须监听 error console.error("Stream error:", err); }); readable.on("data", (chunk) => { /* ... */ });

searchDocs.title: 3. 全局未捕获错误​
searchDocs.content: process.on('uncaughtException', handler): 说明： 当同步代码中抛出的异常没有被任何 try...catch 捕获，最终冒泡到事件循环时触发。用途： 主要用于同步地清理资源、记录致命错误日志，然后退出进程 (process.exit(1))。不应该试图用它来恢复应用的运行，因为进程可能处于不一致状态。 process.on('unhandledRejection', handler): 说明： 当一个 Promise 被 reject，但在事件循环的当前轮次或微任务队列处理结束时，仍然没有 .catch() 处理程序附加到它上面时触发。用途： 记录未处理的 Promise 错误，根据情况决定是否需要退出进程。Node.js 未来版本可能会默认在 unhandledRejection 时终止进程。 最佳实践： 尽量在代码的局部范围内处理错误（使用 try...catch, .catch(), 'error' 监听器）。全局处理器是最后的防线，主要用于日志记录和优雅关闭。

searchDocs.title: 八、 Node.js 调试​
searchDocs.content: console 模块: console.log(): 打印普通信息。console.info(), console.debug(): 类似 log。console.warn(): 打印警告信息。console.error(): 打印错误信息（输出到 stderr）。console.table(data): 将数组或对象以表格形式打印。console.time(label), console.timeEnd(label): 测量代码块执行时间。console.trace(): 打印当前位置的堆栈跟踪。console.assert(assertion, ...messages): 如果 assertion 为 false，则打印消息并抛出 AssertionError。 Node.js 内置调试器 (Legacy): 启动: node inspect your_script.js (或 node debug ... 旧版)。提供命令行调试接口 (cont, next, step, out, watch, repl 等)。使用较少。 Chrome DevTools Inspector (推荐): 启动: node --inspect your_script.js 或 node --inspect-brk your_script.js (-brk 会在第一行暂停)。Node.js 会输出一个 devtools:// URL。在 Chrome 浏览器中打开 chrome://inspect，点击 "Open dedicated DevTools for Node"，或直接访问 Node.js 输出的 URL。提供与前端调试类似的图形化界面：断点、单步执行 (step over, step into, step out)、查看变量、监视表达式、性能分析 (Profiler)、内存分析 (Memory)。 VS Code Debugger: VS Code 内置了强大的 Node.js 调试支持。在代码中设置断点。配置 launch.json 文件（通常可以自动生成）来定义启动和附加调试会话的方式。提供图形化调试界面，与 Chrome DevTools 类似。

searchDocs.title: 九、 总结​
searchDocs.content: Node.js 是一个功能强大且用途广泛的 JavaScript 运行时环境。对于前端开发者而言，掌握 Node.js 不仅是进行现代前端工程化的必备技能，也开启了通往服务端渲染、API 开发乃至全栈开发的大门。理解其事件驱动、非阻塞 I/O 的核心机制，熟练运用异步编程模式、模块系统、核心 API 以及 NPM 包管理，是高效使用 Node.js 的关键。

searchDocs.title: 1.1 什么是 PHP？​
searchDocs.content: PHP (Hypertext Preprocessor) 是一种广泛使用的开源通用脚本语言，特别适用于 Web 开发并可嵌入 HTML 中。它的语法吸收了 C、Java 和 Perl 的特点，易于学习，使用广泛。PHP 主要在服务器端执行，用于生成动态网页内容。

searchDocs.title: 1.2 PHP 的特点​
searchDocs.content: 服务器端脚本语言: 代码在服务器上执行，客户端（浏览器）只接收结果（通常是 HTML）。嵌入式: 可以直接嵌入到 HTML 代码中。跨平台: 可以在多种操作系统上运行（Windows, Linux, macOS 等）。广泛的数据库支持: 支持几乎所有主流数据库（MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Oracle, SQL Server 等）。开源免费: 拥有庞大的社区支持和丰富的文档资源。弱类型语言: 变量类型通常不需要显式声明，PHP 会根据上下文自动转换（但也支持类型声明 Type Hinting）。

searchDocs.title: 2.1 PHP 标记​
searchDocs.content: PHP 代码需要写在特定的标记之间，最常用的是 <?php ... ?>。  <!DOCTYPE html> <html> <head> <title>PHP Basic Syntax</title> </head> <body> <h1> <?php echo "Hello from PHP!"; // PHP code block ?> </h1> <p>This is standard HTML.</p> <?php // Another PHP block $message = "This message is generated by PHP."; echo "<p>" . $message . "</p>"; ?> <?="<p>Short echo tag example.</p>"?> <!-- Short echo tag (requires short_open_tag=On or PHP 5.4+) --> </body> </html>

searchDocs.title: 2.2 注释​
searchDocs.content: 单行注释: // 或 #多行注释: /* ... */  <?php // This is a single-line comment # This is also a single-line comment /* This is a multi-line comment block. It can span multiple lines. */ $name = "Alice"; // Comment after code ?>

searchDocs.title: 2.3 输出内容​
searchDocs.content: 使用 echo 或 print 语句向浏览器输出内容。echo 通常稍快一些，且可以一次输出多个参数。  <?php $greeting = "Hello"; $target = "World"; echo $greeting; // Output: Hello echo "<br>"; // Output HTML line break echo $greeting, " ", $target, "!"; // Output multiple arguments: Hello World! echo "<br>"; print $greeting . " " . $target . " (using print)!"; // Output using print: Hello World (using print)! print "<br>"; $result = print "Print returns 1."; // print returns 1 echo "<br>"; echo "Print returned: " . $result; // Output: Print returned: 1 // echo does not have a meaningful return value like print ?>

searchDocs.title: 3.1 变量​
searchDocs.content: 以 $ 符号开头，后跟变量名。变量名区分大小写。变量名必须以字母或下划线开头。变量在使用前不需要声明，赋值即创建。  <?php $firstName = "Bob"; // String $age = 30; // Integer $price = 19.99; // Float (Double) $isActive = true; // Boolean $_system_status = "OK"; // Variable starting with underscore echo $firstName; // Output: Bob echo "<br>"; echo $Age; // Notice: Undefined variable: Age - demonstrates case sensitivity $firstName = "Charlie"; // Variable value can be changed echo $firstName; // Output: Charlie ?>

searchDocs.title: 3.2 数据类型​
searchDocs.content: PHP 支持多种数据类型：  标量类型 (Scalar Types): string: 字符串 (文本)int (或 integer): 整数float (或 double): 浮点数bool (或 boolean): 布尔值 (true 或 false) 复合类型 (Compound Types): array: 数组 (有序映射)object: 对象 (类的实例)callable: 可调用类型 (函数或方法) 特殊类型 (Special Types): null: 表示变量没有值resource: 特殊变量，表示外部资源 (如数据库连接、文件句柄)  <?php $str = "This is a string"; $count = 100; $pi = 3.14159; $isEnabled = false; $scores = [95, 88, 72]; // Array (short syntax) $person = (object) ['name' => 'David', 'city' => 'London']; // Simple object cast $noValue = NULL; var_dump($str); // string(18) "This is a string" echo "<br>"; var_dump($count); // int(100) echo "<br>"; var_dump($pi); // float(3.14159) echo "<br>"; var_dump($isEnabled); // bool(false) echo "<br>"; var_dump($scores); // array(3) { [0]=> int(95) [1]=> int(88) [2]=> int(72) } echo "<br>"; var_dump($person); // object(stdClass)#1 (2) { ["name"]=> string(5) "David" ["city"]=> string(6) "London" } echo "<br>"; var_dump($noValue); // NULL echo "<br>"; // Resource example (won't show much with var_dump alone without context) // $fileHandle = fopen("myfile.txt", "r"); // var_dump($fileHandle); // resource(id#...) of type (stream) // if ($fileHandle) fclose($fileHandle); ?>

searchDocs.title: 3.3 类型转换 (Type Casting/Juggling)​
searchDocs.content: PHP 会根据上下文自动转换类型（Type Juggling），也可以显式转换（Type Casting）。  <?php $numString = "50"; $numInt = 10; // Implicit conversion (juggling) during arithmetic operation $sum = $numString + $numInt; // $numString is treated as integer 50 echo "Sum (implicit): " . $sum . " (Type: " . gettype($sum) . ")"; // Sum (implicit): 60 (Type: integer) echo "<br>"; // Explicit conversion (casting) $castedInt = (int) $numString; $sumExplicit = $castedInt + $numInt; echo "Sum (explicit): " . $sumExplicit . " (Type: " . gettype($sumExplicit) . ")"; // Sum (explicit): 60 (Type: integer) echo "<br>"; $floatVal = 9.81; $castedToInt = (int) $floatVal; // Cast float to int (truncates decimal) echo "Casted float to int: " . $castedToInt; // Casted float to int: 9 echo "<br>"; $boolVal = (bool) ""; // Empty string casts to false var_dump($boolVal); // bool(false) echo "<br>"; $boolVal = (bool) "0"; // String "0" casts to false var_dump($boolVal); // bool(false) echo "<br>"; $boolVal = (bool) "Hello"; // Non-empty string casts to true var_dump($boolVal); // bool(true) ?>

searchDocs.title: 3.4 常量 (Constants)​
searchDocs.content: 使用 define() 函数或 const 关键字定义常量。常量一旦定义，其值不能改变，且默认是全局作用域。常量名通常全大写。const 关键字用于类常量和全局常量（PHP 5.3+），define() 只能定义全局常量。  <?php // Using define() - can be used anywhere define("SITE_NAME", "My Awesome Website"); define("MAX_USERS", 100); // define("SITE_NAME", "Another Name"); // Error: Constant SITE_NAME already defined echo SITE_NAME; // Output: My Awesome Website echo "<br>"; echo MAX_USERS; // Output: 100 echo "<br>"; // Using const - outside classes, usable only at top-level scope or inside classes (PHP 5.3+) const APP_VERSION = "1.2.0"; echo APP_VERSION; // Output: 1.2.0 echo "<br>"; // const cannot be defined conditionally like define() /* if (true) { const CONDITIONAL_CONST = "Yes"; // Fatal error: const declarations cannot be conditional } */ if (true) { define("CONDITIONAL_DEFINE", "Yes"); // OK echo CONDITIONAL_DEFINE; // Output: Yes } ?>

searchDocs.title: 4.1 算术运算符​
searchDocs.content: + (加), - (减), * (乘), / (除), % (取模), ** (幂 - PHP 5.6+)。  <?php $a = 10; $b = 3; echo $a + $b; // 13 echo "<br>"; echo $a % $b; // 1 echo "<br>"; echo 2 ** 4; // 16 ?>

searchDocs.title: 4.2 赋值运算符​
searchDocs.content: = (赋值), +=, -=, *=, /=, %=, **=, .= (字符串连接赋值)。  <?php $x = 5; $x += 3; // $x is now 8 echo $x; echo "<br>"; $message = "Hello"; $message .= " World!"; // $message is now "Hello World!" echo $message; ?>

searchDocs.title: 4.3 比较运算符​
searchDocs.content: == (等于, 值比较), === (全等, 值和类型比较), != 或 <> (不等于), !== (不全等), <, >, <=, >=。 太空船运算符 <=> (PHP 7+)：用于比较两个表达式。当 $a 小于、等于或大于 $b 时，它分别返回 -1、0 或 1。  <?php $val1 = 10; $val2 = "10"; var_dump($val1 == $val2); // bool(true) - loose comparison (type juggling) echo "<br>"; var_dump($val1 === $val2); // bool(false) - strict comparison (different types) echo "<br>"; var_dump($val1 != $val2); // bool(false) echo "<br>"; var_dump($val1 !== $val2); // bool(true) echo "<br>"; // Spaceship Operator (PHP 7+) $x = 5; $y = 10; echo ($x <=> $y); // -1 ($x < $y) echo "<br>"; echo ($y <=> $x); // 1 ($y > $x) echo "<br>"; echo ($x <=> 5); // 0 ($x == 5) ?>

searchDocs.title: 4.4 逻辑运算符​
searchDocs.content: && 或 and (逻辑与), || 或 or (逻辑或), ! (逻辑非), xor (逻辑异或)。 (&& 和 || 优先级高于 and 和 or)  <?php $isLoggedIn = true; $isAdmin = false; var_dump($isLoggedIn && $isAdmin); // bool(false) echo "<br>"; var_dump($isLoggedIn || $isAdmin); // bool(true) echo "<br>"; var_dump(!$isAdmin); // bool(true) ?>

searchDocs.title: 4.5 递增/递减运算符​
searchDocs.content: ++$var (前置递增), $var++ (后置递增), --$var (前置递减), $var-- (后置递减)。  <?php $counter = 5; echo ++$counter; // 6 (increment then return) echo "<br>"; echo $counter; // 6 echo "<br>"; $counter = 5; echo $counter++; // 5 (return then increment) echo "<br>"; echo $counter; // 6 ?>

searchDocs.title: 4.6 错误控制运算符 (@)​
searchDocs.content: 抑制错误消息的显示。强烈不推荐滥用，应使用适当的错误处理机制。  <?php // Without @, this would likely cause a Notice: Undefined variable: nonExistentVar $value = @$nonExistentVar; echo "Value is: "; var_dump($value); // Value is: NULL // Better approach: check if variable exists if (isset($anotherNonExistentVar)) { $value = $anotherNonExistentVar; } else { $value = "default"; } echo "Value (checked): " . $value; // Value (checked): default ?>

searchDocs.title: 4.7 三元运算符与 Null 合并运算符​
searchDocs.content: 三元运算符: condition ? value_if_true : value_if_falseNull 合并运算符 (?? - PHP 7+): value1 ?? value2 - 如果 value1 存在且不为 NULL，则返回 value1，否则返回 value2。常用于替代 isset() ? ... : ...。Null 合并赋值运算符 (??= - PHP 7.4+): $var ??= default - 如果 $var 不存在或为 NULL，则将其赋值为 default。  <?php // Ternary Operator $age = 20; $status = ($age >= 18) ? "Adult" : "Minor"; echo "Status: " . $status; // Status: Adult echo "<br>"; // Null Coalescing Operator (PHP 7+) $username = $_GET['user'] ?? 'guest'; // If $_GET['user'] is not set or is NULL, use 'guest' echo "Username: " . $username; // Assuming $_GET['user'] is not set, output: Username: guest echo "<br>"; // Equivalent using ternary and isset() $usernameOld = isset($_GET['user']) ? $_GET['user'] : 'guest'; echo "Username (old way): " . $usernameOld; echo "<br>"; // Null Coalescing Assignment Operator (PHP 7.4+) $options['color'] ??= 'blue'; // If $options['color'] is not set or is null, set it to 'blue' $options['size'] = 'large'; $options['size'] ??= 'medium'; // 'size' is already set, so it remains 'large' var_dump($options); // array(2) { ["color"]=> string(4) "blue" ["size"]=> string(5) "large" } ?>

searchDocs.title: 5.1 条件语句 (if, elseif, else)​
searchDocs.content: 根据条件执行不同的代码块。  <?php $grade = 75; if ($grade >= 90) { echo "Grade: A"; } elseif ($grade >= 80) { echo "Grade: B"; } elseif ($grade >= 70) { echo "Grade: C"; } else { echo "Grade: D or F"; } // Output: Grade: C ?>

searchDocs.title: 5.2 switch 语句​
searchDocs.content: 基于一个表达式的值匹配多个 case。  <?php $day = "Monday"; switch ($day) { case "Monday": echo "Start of the work week."; break; // Important! Prevents fall-through case "Friday": echo "Almost weekend!"; break; case "Saturday": case "Sunday": // Multiple cases can share a block echo "It's the weekend!"; break; default: echo "It's a regular weekday."; } // Output: Start of the work week. ?>

searchDocs.title: 5.3 循环语句 (for, while, do...while, foreach)​
searchDocs.content: for: 固定次数循环。while: 条件为真时循环。do...while: 先执行一次，然后条件为真时循环。foreach: 遍历数组或对象的每个元素。  <?php // for loop echo "For Loop: "; for ($i = 0; $i < 3; $i++) { echo $i . " "; // Output: 0 1 2 } echo "<br>"; // while loop echo "While Loop: "; $j = 0; while ($j < 3) { echo $j . " "; // Output: 0 1 2 $j++; } echo "<br>"; // do...while loop echo "Do...While Loop: "; $k = 0; do { echo $k . " "; // Output: 0 1 2 $k++; } while ($k < 3); echo "<br>"; // foreach loop (for arrays) echo "Foreach Loop (Array Values): "; $colors = ["red", "green", "blue"]; foreach ($colors as $color) { echo $color . " "; // Output: red green blue } echo "<br>"; echo "Foreach Loop (Array Keys & Values): "; $person = ["name" => "Eve", "age" => 25]; foreach ($person as $key => $value) { echo $key . ": " . $value . " | "; // Output: name: Eve | age: 25 | } echo "<br>"; ?>

searchDocs.title: 5.4 break 和 continue​
searchDocs.content: break: 跳出当前循环 (或 switch)。continue: 跳过当前循环的剩余部分，进入下一次迭代。  <?php echo "Break/Continue Example: "; for ($i = 0; $i < 5; $i++) { if ($i === 3) { break; // Exit loop when $i is 3 } if ($i === 1) { continue; // Skip iteration when $i is 1 } echo $i . " "; // Output: 0 2 } ?>

searchDocs.title: 5.5 include, require, include_once, require_once​
searchDocs.content: 用于包含并执行其他 PHP 文件。  include: 如果文件不存在，产生警告 (Warning) 并继续执行脚本。require: 如果文件不存在，产生致命错误 (Fatal Error) 并停止执行脚本。include_once, require_once: 功能同上，但会检查文件是否已被包含过，如果已包含则不再包含。这是推荐的方式，以避免函数或类重复定义。  <?php // Assume 'header.php' contains: <?php echo "<h1>Header Content</h1>"; ?> // Assume 'config.php' contains: <?php define("DB_NAME", "mydatabase"); ?> // include_once 'header.php'; // Include header only once // require_once 'config.php'; // Include config only once, critical for script // echo "Database name is: " . DB_NAME; // Example using include (if 'nonexistent.php' doesn't exist): // include 'nonexistent.php'; // Generates Warning, script continues // echo "This line will still execute after include warning."; // Example using require (if 'nonexistent.php' doesn't exist): // require 'nonexistent.php'; // Generates Fatal Error, script stops // echo "This line will NOT execute after require fatal error."; ?>

searchDocs.title: 6.1 定义与调用​
searchDocs.content: 使用 function 关键字定义函数。  <?php // Define a function function greetUser($name) { echo "Hello, " . $name . "!"; } // Call the function greetUser("Alice"); // Output: Hello, Alice! echo "<br>"; // Function with return value function addNumbers($a, $b) { $sum = $a + $b; return $sum; // echo "This won't be executed"; // Code after return is not executed } $result = addNumbers(5, 7); echo "5 + 7 = " . $result; // Output: 5 + 7 = 12 ?>

searchDocs.title: 6.2 函数参数与返回值类型声明 (PHP 7+)​
searchDocs.url: /docs/lang/php/intro#62-函数参数与返回值类型声明-php-7
searchDocs.content: 可以为参数和返回值指定类型（Type Hinting）。在严格模式下 (declare(strict_types=1);) 会强制类型匹配。  <?php declare(strict_types=1); // Enable strict types mode for this file // Function with type hints for parameters and return value function multiply(float $a, float $b) : float { return $a * $b; } $product = multiply(3.5, 2.0); echo "Product: " . $product; // Output: Product: 7 echo "<br>"; // $product = multiply("3.5", 2); // Fatal error in strict mode (string != float) // In non-strict mode, PHP might try to convert "3.5" to float function welcome(string $name, ?string $title = null) : string { // ?string allows NULL if ($title) { return "Welcome, " . $title . " " . $name; } return "Welcome, " . $name; } echo welcome("Bob"); // Output: Welcome, Bob echo "<br>"; echo welcome("Charlie", "Mr."); // Output: Welcome, Mr. Charlie echo "<br>"; echo welcome("Diana", null); // Output: Welcome, Diana ?>

searchDocs.title: 6.3 变量作用域​
searchDocs.content: 局部作用域: 在函数内部定义的变量默认为局部变量，仅在函数内部可用。全局作用域: 在函数外部定义的变量为全局变量。要在函数内部访问全局变量，需使用 global 关键字或 $GLOBALS 超全局数组。静态作用域: 使用 static 关键字在函数内部声明的变量，在函数调用结束后其值会保留，下次调用时仍然存在。  <?php $globalVar = "I am global"; function testScope() { $localVar = "I am local"; echo $localVar; // OK echo "<br>"; // Access global variable method 1: global keyword global $globalVar; echo $globalVar; // OK echo "<br>"; // Access global variable method 2: $GLOBALS array echo $GLOBALS['globalVar']; // OK echo "<br>"; } testScope(); // echo $localVar; // Error: Undefined variable $localVar (outside its scope) echo $globalVar; // OK: Accessing global variable outside function echo "<br>"; // Static variable example function staticCounter() { static $count = 0; // Initialized only on first call $count++; echo $count . " "; } staticCounter(); // 1 staticCounter(); // 2 staticCounter(); // 3 ?>

searchDocs.title: 6.4 可变函数 (Variable Functions)​
searchDocs.content: 将函数名存储在变量中，然后通过变量名加括号 () 来调用该函数。  <?php function sayHello() { echo "Hello!"; } $funcName = "sayHello"; $funcName(); // Calls sayHello(), Output: Hello! ?>

searchDocs.title: 6.5 匿名函数 (Anonymous Functions) / 闭包 (Closures)​
searchDocs.content: 没有名称的函数，通常赋值给变量或作为回调函数传递。可以从父作用域继承变量 (使用 use 关键字)。  <?php // Assign anonymous function to a variable $add = function($a, $b) { return $a + $b; }; echo $add(3, 4); // Output: 7 echo "<br>"; // Closure using 'use' to capture variable from parent scope $message = "World"; $greet = function($greeting) use ($message) { echo $greeting . ", " . $message . "!"; }; $greet("Hello"); // Output: Hello, World! echo "<br>"; // Example as a callback for array_map $numbers = [1, 2, 3, 4]; $squared = array_map(function($n) { return $n * $n; }, $numbers); print_r($squared); // Output: Array ( [0] => 1 [1] => 4 [2] => 9 [3] => 16 ) ?>

searchDocs.title: 6.6 箭头函数 (Arrow Functions - PHP 7.4+)​
searchDocs.content: 匿名函数的简洁语法，特别适用于简单的回调。自动捕获外部作用域变量，无需 use。  <?php // Arrow function equivalent of the $add example above $addArrow = fn($a, $b) => $a + $b; echo $addArrow(10, 5); // Output: 15 echo "<br>"; // Arrow function equivalent of the array_map example $numbers = [1, 2, 3, 4]; $cubed = array_map(fn($n) => $n ** 3, $numbers); print_r($cubed); // Output: Array ( [0] => 1 [1] => 8 [2] => 27 [3] => 64 ) ?>

searchDocs.title: 7. 数组 (Arrays)​
searchDocs.content: PHP 中的数组实际上是有序映射 (Ordered Map)，可以将值与特定的键关联起来。

searchDocs.title: 7.1 类型​
searchDocs.content: 索引数组 (Indexed Arrays): 键是整数，通常从 0 开始自动索引。关联数组 (Associative Arrays): 键是字符串。多维数组 (Multidimensional Arrays): 数组包含其他数组。  <?php // Indexed Array $indexed = [10, 20, 30]; // Short syntax (PHP 5.4+) // $indexed = array(10, 20, 30); // Old syntax echo $indexed[1]; // Output: 20 echo "<br>"; // Associative Array $assoc = [ "name" => "Alice", "age" => 28, "city" => "New York" ]; echo $assoc["name"]; // Output: Alice echo "<br>"; // Adding elements $indexed[] = 40; // Adds 40 at the next available index (3) $assoc["country"] = "USA"; // Adds a new key-value pair print_r($indexed); // Array ( [0] => 10 [1] => 20 [2] => 30 [3] => 40 ) echo "<br>"; print_r($assoc); // Array ( [name] => Alice [age] => 28 [city] => New York [country] => USA ) echo "<br>"; // Multidimensional Array $matrix = [ [1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6], [7, 8, 9] ]; echo $matrix[1][1]; // Output: 5 (Row 1, Column 1 - 0-indexed) ?>

searchDocs.title: 7.2 常用数组函数​
searchDocs.content: PHP 提供了大量处理数组的内置函数。  count() 或 sizeof(): 返回数组元素个数。is_array(): 检查变量是否是数组。in_array(): 检查值是否存在于数组中。array_key_exists() 或 isset(): 检查键是否存在于数组中 (isset 也检查值是否为 null)。array_keys(): 返回数组的所有键。array_values(): 返回数组的所有值。array_push() / array_pop(): 在数组末尾添加/移除元素。array_unshift() / array_shift(): 在数组开头添加/移除元素。array_merge(): 合并一个或多个数组。array_slice(): 提取数组的一部分。sort(), rsort(), asort(), arsort(), ksort(), krsort(): 对数组进行不同方式的排序。array_map(): 对数组的每个元素应用回调函数。array_filter(): 使用回调函数过滤数组元素。array_reduce(): 使用回调函数将数组迭代为单个值。  <?php $myArray = ["a" => 1, "b" => 2, "c" => 3, "d" => 2]; echo "Count: " . count($myArray); // Count: 4 echo "<br>"; var_dump(in_array(2, $myArray)); // bool(true) echo "<br>"; var_dump(array_key_exists("c", $myArray)); // bool(true) echo "<br>"; print_r(array_keys($myArray)); // Array ( [0] => a [1] => b [2] => c [3] => d ) echo "<br>"; print_r(array_values($myArray)); // Array ( [0] => 1 [1] => 2 [2] => 3 [3] => 2 ) echo "<br>"; // Example: array_map $numbers = [1, 2, 3]; $doubled = array_map(fn($n) => $n * 2, $numbers); print_r($doubled); // Array ( [0] => 2 [1] => 4 [2] => 6 ) echo "<br>"; // Example: array_filter $evenNumbers = array_filter($numbers, fn($n) => $n % 2 == 0); print_r($evenNumbers); // Array ( [1] => 2 ) (Keys are preserved) echo "<br>"; // Example: array_reduce $sum = array_reduce($numbers, fn($carry, $item) => $carry + $item, 0); // 0 is initial carry echo "Sum: " . $sum; // Sum: 6 ?>

searchDocs.title: 8. 面向对象编程 (OOP)​
searchDocs.content: PHP 具有完整的面向对象特性。

searchDocs.title: 8.1 类与对象​
searchDocs.content: 类 (Class): 定义对象的蓝图（属性和方法）。对象 (Object): 类的实例。  <?php // Define a class class Car { // Properties (member variables) - Type hinting PHP 7.4+ public string $make; public string $model; private int $year; // Private property // Constructor method (called when creating an object) public function __construct(string $make, string $model, int $year) { $this->make = $make; // $this refers to the current object $this->model = $model; $this->setYear($year); // Use setter for validation echo "Car object created: " . $this->getInfo() . "<br>"; } // Method (member function) public function getInfo(): string { return $this->make . " " . $this->model . " (" . $this->year . ")"; } // Setter method for private property public function setYear(int $year): void { if ($year > 1886 && $year <= date("Y") + 1) { // Basic validation $this->year = $year; } else { throw new InvalidArgumentException("Invalid year provided."); } } // Getter method for private property public function getYear(): int { return $this->year; } // Destructor method (called when object is destroyed or script ends) public function __destruct() { // echo "Car object destroyed: " . $this->make . " " . $this->model . "<br>"; } } // Create objects (instances) of the Car class $car1 = new Car("Toyota", "Camry", 2021); $car2 = new Car("Honda", "Civic", 2022); // Access public properties and methods echo $car1->make; // Output: Toyota echo "<br>"; echo $car2->getInfo(); // Output: Honda Civic (2022) echo "<br>"; // Cannot access private property directly // echo $car1->year; // Fatal error: Cannot access private property Car::$year // Access private property via getter echo "Car 1 Year: " . $car1->getYear(); // Output: Car 1 Year: 2021 // $car3 = new Car("Ford", "Model T", 1800); // Throws InvalidArgumentException ?>

searchDocs.title: 8.2 继承 (Inheritance)​
searchDocs.content: 一个类（子类）可以继承另一个类（父类）的属性和方法。使用 extends 关键字。使用 parent:: 访问父类的方法或属性。  <?php class Vehicle { public string $color; public function __construct(string $color = 'white') { $this->color = $color; } public function honk(): void { echo "Generic honk!"; } } // Truck inherits from Vehicle class Truck extends Vehicle { public int $payloadCapacity; public function __construct(string $color, int $capacity) { parent::__construct($color); // Call parent constructor $this->payloadCapacity = $capacity; } // Override parent method public function honk(): void { echo "Truck horn sound!"; } public function getTruckInfo(): string { return "Color: " . $this->color . ", Capacity: " . $this->payloadCapacity . "kg"; } } $myTruck = new Truck("Red", 5000); echo $myTruck->getTruckInfo(); // Output: Color: Red, Capacity: 5000kg echo "<br>"; $myTruck->honk(); // Output: Truck horn sound! (Overridden method) echo "<br>"; // Accessing parent method explicitly (if needed and not overridden, or from within child) // parent::honk(); // Can be used inside Truck methods ?>

searchDocs.title: 8.3 访问修饰符 (Visibility)​
searchDocs.content: 控制属性和方法的可见性：  public: 可以在任何地方访问。protected: 只能在类自身及其子类中访问。private: 只能在定义它的类自身中访问。  <?php class MyClass { public $publicVar = "Public"; protected $protectedVar = "Protected"; private $privateVar = "Private"; public function testAccess() { echo $this->publicVar; // OK echo "<br>"; echo $this->protectedVar; // OK echo "<br>"; echo $this->privateVar; // OK echo "<br>"; } } class SubClass extends MyClass { public function testSubAccess() { echo $this->publicVar; // OK echo "<br>"; echo $this->protectedVar; // OK (can access protected from parent) echo "<br>"; // echo $this->privateVar; // Fatal error: Cannot access private property MyClass::$privateVar } } $obj = new MyClass(); echo $obj->publicVar; // OK echo "<br>"; // echo $obj->protectedVar; // Fatal error // echo $obj->privateVar; // Fatal error $obj->testAccess(); // Accesses all internally echo "<hr>"; $subObj = new SubClass(); echo $subObj->publicVar; // OK echo "<br>"; $subObj->testSubAccess(); // Accesses public and protected ?>

searchDocs.title: 8.4 静态属性与方法 (static)​
searchDocs.content: 属于类本身，而不是类的实例。通过类名加 :: (范围解析操作符) 访问。  <?php class Counter { public static int $count = 0; // Static property public function __construct() { self::$count++; // Access static property using self:: inside the class } public static function getCount(): int { // Static method return self::$count; } } $c1 = new Counter(); $c2 = new Counter(); echo Counter::$count; // Access static property using ClassName:: (Output: 2) echo "<br>"; echo Counter::getCount(); // Call static method (Output: 2) ?>

searchDocs.title: 8.5 抽象类与方法 (abstract)​
searchDocs.content: 抽象类: 不能被实例化，只能被继承。可以包含抽象方法和普通方法。抽象方法: 只有声明，没有具体实现。子类必须实现父类所有的抽象方法。  <?php abstract class AbstractShape { abstract public function getArea(): float; // Abstract method declaration public function getDescription(): string { // Regular method return "This is a shape."; } } class Circle extends AbstractShape { private float $radius; public function __construct(float $radius) { $this->radius = $radius; } // Must implement the abstract method public function getArea(): float { return pi() * $this->radius * $this->radius; } } class Rectangle extends AbstractShape { private float $width; private float $height; public function __construct(float $width, float $height) { $this->width = $width; $this->height = $height; } public function getArea(): float { return $this->width * $this->height; } } // $shape = new AbstractShape(); // Fatal error: Cannot instantiate abstract class $circle = new Circle(5); echo $circle->getDescription() . " Area: " . $circle->getArea(); // This is a shape. Area: 78.539... echo "<br>"; $rectangle = new Rectangle(4, 6); echo $rectangle->getDescription() . " Area: " . $rectangle->getArea(); // This is a shape. Area: 24 ?>

searchDocs.title: 8.6 接口 (interface)​
searchDocs.content: 定义类必须实现的方法契约，但接口本身不提供实现。类可以实现多个接口 (使用 implements)。  <?php interface Loggable { public function log(string $message): void; // Interface methods are implicitly public and abstract } interface Editable { public function edit(string $content): bool; } // Class implementing multiple interfaces class Document implements Loggable, Editable { private string $content = ''; public function log(string $message): void { echo "[LOG] Document: " . $message . "<br>"; } public function edit(string $content): bool { $this->content = $content; $this->log("Content updated."); return true; } public function getContent(): string { return $this->content; } } $doc = new Document(); $doc->edit("This is the new document content."); echo "Document Content: " . $doc->getContent(); // Output: // [LOG] Document: Content updated. // Document Content: This is the new document content. ?>

searchDocs.title: 8.7 Trait (PHP 5.4+)​
searchDocs.content: 一种代码复用机制，用于在类之间共享方法实现，解决单继承的限制。使用 trait 关键字定义，use 关键字在类中使用。  <?php trait LoggerTrait { public function logMessage(string $level, string $message): void { echo "[" . strtoupper($level) . "] " . $message . "<br>"; } } trait UtilityTrait { public function generateId(): string { return uniqid(); } } class User { use LoggerTrait; // Use the Logger trait use UtilityTrait; // Use the Utility trait public string $name; public string $id; public function __construct(string $name) { $this->name = $name; $this->id = $this->generateId(); // Method from UtilityTrait $this->logMessage('info', "User created: {$this->name} (ID: {$this->id})"); // Method from LoggerTrait } } class Order { use LoggerTrait; public int $orderId; public function __construct(int $id) { $this->orderId = $id; $this->logMessage('info', "Order created: #{$this->orderId}"); } } $user = new User("Frank"); $order = new Order(123); // Output: // [INFO] User created: Frank (ID: <unique_id>) // [INFO] Order created: #123 ?>

searchDocs.title: 9. 超全局变量 (Superglobals)​
searchDocs.content: PHP 提供了一些预定义的全局变量，称为超全局变量，可以在脚本的任何作用域中直接访问，无需 global 关键字。  $GLOBALS: 包含所有全局变量的关联数组。$_SERVER: 包含服务器和执行环境信息（如请求头、路径、脚本位置）。$_GET: 包含通过 HTTP GET 方法传递给脚本的变量（URL 查询参数）。$_POST: 包含通过 HTTP POST 方法传递给脚本的变量（通常来自表单提交）。$_REQUEST: 包含 $_GET, $_POST, 和 $_COOKIE 的内容（顺序和可用性取决于 request_order 配置）。谨慎使用，优先使用 $_GET 或 $_POST。$_FILES: 包含通过 HTTP POST 文件上传方式传递给脚本的项目。$_COOKIE: 包含通过 HTTP Cookies 传递给脚本的变量。$_SESSION: 包含会话变量。需要先启动会话 (session_start())。$_ENV: 包含通过环境方法传递给脚本的变量。  <?php // Example usage (run this script via a web server) echo "Script Name: " . ($_SERVER['SCRIPT_NAME'] ?? 'N/A') . "<br>"; echo "Request Method: " . ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'N/A') . "<br>"; // Accessing GET parameter (e.g., script.php?name=Alice) $name = $_GET['name'] ?? 'Guest'; echo "Name from GET: " . htmlspecialchars($name) . "<br>"; // Use htmlspecialchars for security! // Accessing POST parameter (from a form submission) $email = $_POST['email'] ?? 'Not provided'; echo "Email from POST: " . htmlspecialchars($email) . "<br>"; // Accessing Cookie (assuming a cookie named 'user_preference' exists) $preference = $_COOKIE['user_preference'] ?? 'Default'; echo "User Preference Cookie: " . htmlspecialchars($preference) . "<br>"; // Session example needs session_start() at the top of the script // session_start(); // $_SESSION['views'] = ($_SESSION['views'] ?? 0) + 1; // echo "Page views this session: " . $_SESSION['views'] . "<br>"; ?> <!-- Example HTML Form to send POST data --> <form method="POST" action="<?php echo htmlspecialchars($_SERVER['PHP_SELF']); ?>"> Email: <input type="email" name="email"> <button type="submit">Submit</button> </form>

searchDocs.title: 10. 处理 Web 表单​
searchDocs.content: 结合 HTML 表单和 PHP 超全局变量 $_GET 或 $_POST 来接收和处理用户输入。关键在于验证和清理用户输入以防止安全漏洞。  <?php $name = ''; $email = ''; $errors = []; // Check if the form was submitted using POST if ($_SERVER["REQUEST_METHOD"] == "POST") { // --- Input Validation & Sanitization --- // Validate Name if (empty(trim($_POST["name"]))) { $errors[] = "Name is required."; } else { $name = htmlspecialchars(strip_tags(trim($_POST["name"]))); // Sanitize } // Validate Email if (empty(trim($_POST["email"]))) { $errors[] = "Email is required."; } elseif (!filter_var(trim($_POST["email"]), FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) { $errors[] = "Invalid email format."; } else { $email = htmlspecialchars(strip_tags(trim($_POST["email"]))); // Sanitize } // --- Process Data (if no errors) --- if (empty($errors)) { echo "<h2>Form Submitted Successfully!</h2>"; echo "<p>Name: " . $name . "</p>"; echo "<p>Email: " . $email . "</p>"; // Here you would typically save to database, send email, etc. $name = $email = ''; // Clear form fields after successful submission } } ?> <!DOCTYPE html> <html> <head><title>PHP Form Handling</title></head> <body> <h2>Contact Form</h2> <?php // Display errors if any if (!empty($errors)) { echo '<div style="color: red;">'; echo '<ul>'; foreach ($errors as $error) { echo '<li>' . $error . '</li>'; } echo '</ul>'; echo '</div>'; } ?> <form method="POST" action="<?php echo htmlspecialchars($_SERVER["PHP_SELF"]); ?>"> <div> <label for="name">Name:</label> <input type="text" id="name" name="name" value="<?php echo $name; ?>"> </div> <br> <div> <label for="email">Email:</label> <input type="text" id="email" name="email" value="<?php echo $email; ?>"> </div> <br> <button type="submit">Submit</button> </form> </body> </html>

searchDocs.title: 11. Sessions 和 Cookies​
searchDocs.content: 用于在不同页面请求之间维持用户状态。  Cookies: 存储在用户浏览器中的小文件。通过 setcookie() 函数设置，通过 $_COOKIE 超全局变量访问。Sessions: 数据存储在服务器上，浏览器只存储一个唯一的会话 ID (通常通过 cookie)。更安全，适合存储敏感信息。需要使用 session_start() 启动会话，通过 $_SESSION 超全局变量读写。  <?php // --- Session Example --- // Must be called before any output session_start(); // Set session variables $_SESSION['username'] = 'Alice'; $_SESSION['user_role'] = 'admin'; // Retrieve session variable $username = $_SESSION['username'] ?? 'Guest'; echo "Welcome back, " . htmlspecialchars($username) . "!<br>"; // Unset a session variable // unset($_SESSION['user_role']); // Destroy the entire session // if (isset($_POST['logout'])) { // session_destroy(); // echo "Session destroyed.<br>"; // } // --- Cookie Example --- $cookie_name = "user_visit"; $cookie_value = "visited"; // setcookie(name, value, expire, path, domain, secure, httponly); // Expire in 1 hour (3600 seconds) setcookie($cookie_name, $cookie_value, time() + 3600, "/"); // Set cookie echo "Cookie '" . $cookie_name . "' is set.<br>"; // Retrieve cookie value (available on subsequent requests) if(isset($_COOKIE[$cookie_name])) { echo "Cookie '" . $cookie_name . "' value is: " . htmlspecialchars($_COOKIE[$cookie_name]) . "<br>"; } else { echo "Cookie '" . $cookie_name . "' is not set (or first visit).<br>"; } // To delete a cookie, set its expiration date in the past // setcookie($cookie_name, "", time() - 3600, "/"); ?>

searchDocs.title: 12.1 错误报告级别​
searchDocs.content: 使用 error_reporting() 函数和 display_errors ini 指令控制错误的显示。开发环境通常显示所有错误，生产环境应记录错误日志但不向用户显示。  <?php // Development: Show all errors error_reporting(E_ALL); ini_set('display_errors', '1'); // Or 'On' // Production: Log errors, don't display // error_reporting(E_ALL); // ini_set('display_errors', '0'); // Or 'Off' // ini_set('log_errors', '1'); // ini_set('error_log', '/path/to/php-error.log'); // Specify log file path // Triggering different error levels (examples) // echo $undefinedVariable; // Notice // include 'nonexistent_file.php'; // Warning // require 'nonexistent_file.php'; // Fatal Error (stops script) // call_undefined_function(); // Fatal Error ?>

searchDocs.title: 12.2 try...catch 异常处理​
searchDocs.content: 用于处理可预见的运行时错误（异常）。  <?php function checkPositive(int $number): bool { if ($number <= 0) { throw new Exception("Number must be positive."); // Throw an exception } return true; } try { echo "Checking 5...<br>"; checkPositive(5); echo "5 is positive.<br>"; echo "Checking -2...<br>"; checkPositive(-2); // This will throw an exception echo "-2 is positive (This won't be reached).<br>"; } catch (Exception $e) { // Catch the thrown exception echo "Caught Exception: " . $e->getMessage() . "<br>"; // Handle the error // echo "File: " . $e->getFile() . "<br>"; // echo "Line: " . $e->getLine() . "<br>"; } finally { // This block always executes, whether an exception occurred or not echo "Finished checking process.<br>"; } echo "Script continues after try-catch.<br>"; ?>

searchDocs.title: 13. 文件处理​
searchDocs.content:
PHP 可以读取、写入、创建和操作服务器上的文件。  <?php $filename = "mydata.txt"; // --- Writing to a file --- // fopen mode 'w': write-only, creates file if not exists, truncates if exists $fileHandleWrite = fopen($filename, "w"); if ($fileHandleWrite) { fwrite($fileHandleWrite, "Hello from PHP!
"); fwrite($fileHandleWrite, "Writing a second line.
"); fclose($fileHandleWrite); // Always close the file handle echo "Data written to " . $filename . "<br>"; } else { echo "Could not open file for writing.<br>"; } // --- Reading from a file --- // fopen mode 'r': read-only, pointer at the beginning $fileHandleRead = fopen($filename, "r"); if ($fileHandleRead) { echo "Reading from " . $filename . ":<br>"; // Read line by line until end of file while (($line = fgets($fileHandleRead)) !== false) { echo htmlspecialchars($line) . "<br>"; } fclose($fileHandleRead); } else { echo "Could not open file for reading.<br>"; } // --- Simpler file writing/reading (for basic cases) --- // file_put_contents (writes entire string, handles open/close) $content = "Simpler write.
Another line."; if (file_put_contents($filename, $content) !== false) { echo "Data written using file_put_contents.<br>"; } // file_get_contents (reads entire file into a string) $readContent = file_get_contents($filename); if ($readContent !== false) { echo "Content read using file_get_contents:<br><pre>" . htmlspecialchars($readContent) . "</pre>"; } // --- Check if file exists --- if (file_exists($filename)) { echo $filename . " exists.<br>"; } // --- Delete file --- // unlink($filename); // echo $filename . " deleted.<br>"; ?>

searchDocs.title: 14. 数据库交互 (PDO)​
searchDocs.content: PDO (PHP Data Objects) 提供了一个统一的接口来访问多种数据库（MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite 等），是现代 PHP 中推荐的数据库交互方式。它支持预处理语句（Prepared Statements）以防止 SQL 注入。  <?php // --- Database Configuration (Replace with your actual details) --- $db_host = "localhost"; // Or your DB host IP/domain $db_name = "test_database"; $db_user = "root"; // Replace with your DB username $db_pass = ""; // Replace with your DB password $charset = 'utf8mb4'; // --- PDO Connection String (DSN) --- $dsn = "mysql:host=$db_host;dbname=$db_name;charset=$charset"; // --- PDO Options --- $options = [ PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION, // Throw exceptions on errors PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_ASSOC, // Fetch results as associative arrays PDO::ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES => false, // Use native prepared statements ]; // --- Connect to Database --- try { $pdo = new PDO($dsn, $db_user, $db_pass, $options); echo "Database connection successful!<br>"; // --- Example: Insert Data (using Prepared Statement) --- $sql_insert = "INSERT INTO users (name, email) VALUES (?, ?)"; // Placeholders ? $stmt_insert = $pdo->prepare($sql_insert); // Execute with data array - protects against SQL injection // $stmt_insert->execute(['Alice Wonderland', 'alice@example.com']); // $stmt_insert->execute(['Bob The Builder', 'bob@example.com']); // echo "Data inserted successfully.<br>"; // --- Example: Select Data (using Prepared Statement) --- $user_id = 1; // Example ID to fetch $sql_select = "SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE id = :id"; // Named placeholder :id $stmt_select = $pdo->prepare($sql_select); // Bind named placeholder $stmt_select->bindParam(':id', $user_id, PDO::PARAM_INT); $stmt_select->execute(); // Fetch a single row $user = $stmt_select->fetch(); // Default is PDO::FETCH_ASSOC from options if ($user) { echo "Fetched User:<pre>"; print_r($user); echo "</pre>"; } else { echo "User with ID " . $user_id . " not found.<br>"; } // --- Example: Select Multiple Rows --- $sql_select_all = "SELECT id, name FROM users ORDER BY name"; // No user input, so prepare/execute can be simplified (though prepare is still good practice) $stmt_all = $pdo->query($sql_select_all); // Direct query for simple selects echo "All Users:<br><ul>"; while ($row = $stmt_all->fetch()) { // Fetch rows one by one echo "<li>ID: " . htmlspecialchars((string)$row['id']) . " - Name: " . htmlspecialchars($row['name']) . "</li>"; } echo "</ul>"; } catch (PDOException $e) { // Handle connection errors echo "Database Connection Error: " . $e->getMessage() . "<br>"; // In a real app, log the error and show a generic message to the user // throw new PDOException($e->getMessage(), (int)$e->getCode()); die("Could not connect to the database. Please try again later."); } // Close connection (optional, PHP usually handles this at script end) // $pdo = null; ?>

searchDocs.title: 15. Namespaces​
searchDocs.content: 用于组织代码和防止命名冲突，尤其在大型项目或使用第三方库时。使用 namespace 关键字声明命名空间，使用 use 关键字导入或别名化其他命名空间中的类、函数或常量。  <?php // --- File: src/MyApp/Database/Connection.php --- namespace MyApp\Database; // Declare namespace class Connection { public function connect() { echo "Connecting from MyApp\\Database\\Connection...<br>"; } } // --- File: src/MyApp/Utils/Logger.php --- namespace MyApp\Utils; class Logger { public function log($message) { echo "[MyApp Utils Logger] " . $message . "<br>"; } } const VERSION = "1.0"; function helperFunc() { echo "Helper function from MyApp\\Utils called.<br>"; } // --- File: index.php --- // require_once 'src/MyApp/Database/Connection.php'; // Assume autoloading in real app // require_once 'src/MyApp/Utils/Logger.php'; // Use 'use' to import classes, functions, constants use MyApp\Database\Connection; use MyApp\Utils\Logger as UtilsLogger; // Alias Logger to avoid potential conflicts use function MyApp\Utils\helperFunc; // Import function use const MyApp\Utils\VERSION as UTILS_VERSION; // Import constant // Fully qualified name (always works) // $conn = new \MyApp\Database\Connection(); // $conn->connect(); // Using imported class $conn = new Connection(); $conn->connect(); // Output: Connecting from MyApp\Database\Connection... // Using aliased class $logger = new UtilsLogger(); $logger->log("Application started."); // Output: [MyApp Utils Logger] Application started. // Using imported function helperFunc(); // Output: Helper function from MyApp\Utils called. // Using imported constant echo "Utils Version: " . UTILS_VERSION; // Output: Utils Version: 1.0 ?>

searchDocs.title: 16. Composer​
searchDocs.content: PHP 的依赖管理工具。用于声明项目依赖的库，并管理它们的安装和自动加载。虽然 Composer 本身不是 PHP 语言特性，但它是现代 PHP 开发的核心工具。  composer.json: 定义项目元数据和依赖项。composer install: 根据 composer.json (或 composer.lock) 安装依赖项到 vendor 目录。composer update: 更新依赖项到最新允许的版本，并更新 composer.lock。Autoloading: Composer 生成 vendor/autoload.php 文件，只需在项目中 require 这一个文件，即可自动加载所有通过 Composer 安装的库以及你自己的符合 PSR-4 规范的代码。  // Example composer.json { "name": "my-vendor/my-project", "description": "A sample project.", "require": { "php": ">=8.0", // Require PHP version 8.0 or higher "monolog/monolog": "^2.0" // Require Monolog library version 2.x }, "autoload": { "psr-4": { "MyApp\\": "src/" // Map MyApp namespace to src/ directory } } }   <?php // index.php (after running 'composer install') // Include Composer's autoloader require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php'; use Monolog\Logger; use Monolog\Handler\StreamHandler; use MyApp\MyClass; // Assuming you have src/MyClass.php with namespace MyApp // Use a class from a Composer package $log = new Logger('main'); $log->pushHandler(new StreamHandler('app.log', Logger::WARNING)); $log->warning('This is a warning message.'); // Use your own class via PSR-4 autoloading // $myApp = new MyClass(); // $myApp->doSomething(); echo "Composer example finished. Check app.log for warning."; ?>

searchDocs.title: 17. JSON 处理​
searchDocs.content: PHP 内置函数用于处理 JSON 数据，这在 Web API 交互中非常常见。  json_encode(): 将 PHP 数组或对象转换为 JSON 字符串。json_decode(): 将 JSON 字符串解析为 PHP 数组或对象。  <?php // --- Encoding PHP array to JSON --- $dataArray = [ "name" => "Gadget", "version" => 1.5, "features" => ["featureA", "featureB"], "enabled" => true ]; $jsonString = json_encode($dataArray, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES); echo "Encoded JSON:<pre>" . htmlspecialchars($jsonString) . "</pre>"; /* Output: Encoded JSON: { "name": "Gadget", "version": 1.5, "features": [ "featureA", "featureB" ], "enabled": true } */ // --- Decoding JSON string to PHP --- $receivedJson = '{ "id": 123, "item": "Widget", "in_stock": false, "location": null }'; // Decode to PHP object (default) $phpObject = json_decode($receivedJson); echo "Decoded Object:<pre>"; var_dump($phpObject); echo "</pre>"; echo "Item from object: " . htmlspecialchars($phpObject->item) . "<br>"; // Access using -> // Decode to PHP associative array $phpArray = json_decode($receivedJson, true); // Pass true as the second argument echo "Decoded Array:<pre>"; var_dump($phpArray); echo "</pre>"; echo "Item from array: " . htmlspecialchars($phpArray['item']) . "<br>"; // Access using ['key'] // Handling JSON errors (PHP 5.3+) json_decode("{ invalid json "); // Malformed JSON $errorCode = json_last_error(); if ($errorCode !== JSON_ERROR_NONE) { echo "JSON Decode Error: " . json_last_error_msg() . " (Code: " . $errorCode . ")<br>"; } ?>

searchDocs.title: 18. 基本安全考量​
searchDocs.content: 输入验证: 永远不要信任用户输入。使用 filter_var(), 正则表达式等验证数据格式、类型、范围。输出转义: 在 HTML 中显示用户提供的数据时，使用 htmlspecialchars() 防止 XSS (跨站脚本攻击)。SQL 注入防护: 使用预处理语句 (Prepared Statements) 和参数绑定 (如 PDO 示例所示)。密码哈希: 存储密码时，使用 password_hash() 生成强哈希，使用 password_verify() 进行验证。不要存储明文密码或使用弱哈希算法 (如 MD5, SHA1)。会话安全: 使用 session_regenerate_id() 防止会话固定攻击，配置安全的 session cookie (httponly, secure)。文件上传安全: 验证文件类型、大小，不要使用用户提供的文件名直接存储文件，将上传目录置于 Web 根目录之外。  <?php // --- Output Escaping --- $userInput = '<script>alert("XSS Attack!");</script>'; // Incorrect (Vulnerable): echo $userInput; // Correct: echo "Escaped Output: " . htmlspecialchars($userInput, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . "<br>"; // --- Input Validation --- $userAge = $_POST['age'] ?? 'abc'; if (filter_var($userAge, FILTER_VALIDATE_INT, ["options" => ["min_range" => 0, "max_range" => 120]])) { echo "Valid age: " . $userAge . "<br>"; } else { echo "Invalid age provided: " . htmlspecialchars($userAge) . "<br>"; } // --- Password Hashing --- $plainPassword = "mySecretPassword123"; $hashedPassword = password_hash($plainPassword, PASSWORD_DEFAULT); // Use default strong algorithm echo "Hashed Password: " . $hashedPassword . "<br>"; // --- Password Verification --- $loginAttempt = "mySecretPassword123"; if (password_verify($loginAttempt, $hashedPassword)) { echo "Password is valid!<br>"; } else { echo "Invalid password!<br>"; } ?>

searchDocs.title: 1.1 什么是 TypeScript？​
searchDocs.content: TypeScript 是 JavaScript 的一个超集，它向 JavaScript 添加了静态类型系统。这意味着你可以在代码编写阶段就定义变量、函数参数和返回值的类型，并在编译时进行检查。TypeScript 代码最终会被编译成纯 JavaScript 代码，可以在任何支持 JavaScript 的环境中运行。

searchDocs.title: 1.2 为什么使用 TypeScript？​
searchDocs.content: 静态类型检查: 在编译阶段就能发现许多常见的错误（如拼写错误、类型不匹配），减少运行时 Bug。代码可读性和可维护性: 类型注解使得代码意图更清晰，便于团队协作和长期维护。更好的开发工具支持: 类型信息能让 IDE（如 VS Code）提供更智能的代码补全、重构和错误提示。访问最新 JavaScript 特性: TypeScript 允许你使用 ECMAScript 的最新特性，并可以编译到旧版本的 JavaScript 以兼容旧环境。

searchDocs.title: 2. 基础类型 (Basic Types)​
searchDocs.content: TypeScript 支持与 JavaScript 几乎相同的基本数据类型，并提供了明确的类型注解。

searchDocs.title: 2.1 boolean​
searchDocs.content: 表示布尔值 true 或 false。  let isDone: boolean = false; // isDone = 'hello'; // Error: Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'boolean'.

searchDocs.title: 2.2 number​
searchDocs.content: 表示所有数字，包括整数和浮点数。  let decimal: number = 6; let hex: number = 0xf00d; let binary: number = 0b1010; let octal: number = 0o744; let score: number = 99.5;

searchDocs.title: 2.3 string​
searchDocs.content: 表示文本数据，可以使用单引号 (')、双引号 (") 或模板字符串 (`)。  let color: string = "blue"; color = "red"; let fullName: string = `Bob Bobbington`; let age: number = 37; let sentence: string = `Hello, my name is ${fullName}. I'll be ${age + 1} years old next month.`;

searchDocs.title: 2.4 array​
searchDocs.content: 表示数组，有两种定义方式：  元素类型后跟 []使用数组泛型 Array<元素类型>  // 方式一 let list1: number[] = [1, 2, 3]; // list1.push('4'); // Error: Argument of type 'string' is not assignable to parameter of type 'number'. // 方式二 let list2: Array<string> = ["a", "b", "c"];

searchDocs.title: 2.5 tuple (元组)​
searchDocs.content: 元组类型允许表示一个已知元素数量和类型的数组，各元素的类型不必相同。  let x: [string, number]; x = ["hello", 10]; // OK // x = [10, 'hello']; // Error: Type 'number' is not assignable to type 'string'. Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'number'. console.log(x[0].substring(1)); // OK // console.log(x[1].substring(1)); // Error: Property 'substring' does not exist on type 'number'. // x[2] = 'world'; // Error: Tuple type '[string, number]' of length '2' has no element at index '2'. (Length is fixed unless configured differently)

searchDocs.title: 2.6 enum (枚举)​
searchDocs.content: 枚举类型是对 JavaScript 标准数据类型的一个补充，它允许你为一组数值赋予友好的名字。  enum Color { Red, // 默认从 0 开始 Green, // 1 Blue, // 2 } let c: Color = Color.Green; console.log(c); // 输出 1 enum Status { Pending = 1, Processing, // 自动递增为 2 Completed, // 自动递增为 3 } let currentStatus: Status = Status.Processing; console.log(currentStatus); // 输出 2 // 也可以通过值获取名字 let colorName: string = Color[2]; console.log(colorName); // 输出 'Blue'

searchDocs.title: 2.7 any​
searchDocs.content: any 类型允许你绕过编译时的类型检查。当你不确定某个值的类型时，或者它来自于动态内容（如用户输入或第三方库），可以使用 any。应尽量避免使用 any，因为它会失去 TypeScript 的类型保护优势。  let notSure: any = 4; notSure = "maybe a string instead"; notSure = false; // okay, definitely a boolean notSure.toFixed(); // Okay, toFixed exists (but may fail at runtime if notSure is not a number) notSure.nonExistentMethod(); // Okay at compile time, will fail at runtime

searchDocs.title: 2.8 unknown​
searchDocs.content: unknown 是 any 的类型安全对应物。任何类型的值都可以赋给 unknown，但你不能对 unknown 类型的值执行任何操作，除非你先进行了类型检查或类型断言，将其缩小（narrow down）为更具体的类型。  let maybe: unknown; maybe = 10; maybe = "hello"; // console.log(maybe.length); // Error: Object is of type 'unknown'. if (typeof maybe === "string") { // 在这个块中，TypeScript 知道 maybe 是 string 类型 console.log(maybe.length); // OK } // 使用类型断言 let strLength: number = (maybe as string).length; // OK, but potentially unsafe if maybe is not a string at runtime

searchDocs.title: 2.9 void​
searchDocs.content: void 表示没有任何类型。通常用作不返回任何值的函数的返回值类型。  function warnUser(): void { console.log("This is my warning message"); // return undefined; // OK // return null; // OK if strictNullChecks is false // return "hello"; // Error: Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'void'. } let unusable: void = undefined; // 可以赋值为 undefined 或 null (取决于 strictNullChecks) // unusable = null; // OK if strictNullChecks is false

searchDocs.title: 2.10 null 和 undefined​
searchDocs.content: 默认情况下 null 和 undefined 是所有类型的子类型，可以赋值给任何类型。但当启用 strictNullChecks 编译选项时，null 和 undefined 只能赋值给 void 和它们各自的类型。通常推荐启用 strictNullChecks。  // 启用 strictNullChecks: true let u: undefined = undefined; let n: null = null; // let num: number = undefined; // Error // let str: string = null; // Error // 可以使用联合类型显式允许 null 或 undefined let nullableString: string | null = null; nullableString = "hello"; let undefinableNumber: number | undefined = undefined; undefinableNumber = 100;

searchDocs.title: 2.11 never​
searchDocs.content: never 类型表示的是那些永不存在的值的类型。例如，never 类型是那些总是会抛出异常或根本就不会有返回值的函数表达式（如无限循环）的返回值类型。never 类型是任何类型的子类型，也可以赋值给任何类型；然而，没有类型是 never 的子类型或可以赋值给 never 类型（除了 never 本身之外）。  // Function returning never must not have a reachable end point function error(message: string): never { throw new Error(message); } // Inferred return type is never function fail() { return error("Something failed"); } // Function returning never must not have a reachable end point function infiniteLoop(): never { while (true) {} }

searchDocs.title: 2.12 object​
searchDocs.content: object 表示非原始类型，也就是除了 number, string, boolean, symbol, null, undefined 之外的类型。  declare function create(o: object | null): void; create({ prop: 0 }); // OK create(null); // OK create([1, 2, 3]); // OK create(function () {}); // OK // create(42); // Error: Argument of type 'number' is not assignable to parameter of type 'object | null'. // create("string"); // Error // create(false); // Error // create(undefined); // Error (if strictNullChecks is true)   注意: 更常用的是 interface 或具体的对象类型字面量来描述对象结构。

searchDocs.title: 3. 接口 (Interfaces)​
searchDocs.content: 接口是 TypeScript 的核心原则之一，用于定义对象的“形状”或“契约”。它们用于类型检查，强制某些结构必须存在。

searchDocs.title: 3.1 定义接口​
searchDocs.content: 使用 interface 关键字定义。  interface Person { firstName: string; lastName: string; age: number; } function greet(person: Person) { console.log(`Hello, ${person.firstName} ${person.lastName}`); } let user: Person = { firstName: "Jane", lastName: "User", age: 30 }; greet(user); // OK // let badUser = { firstName: "John" }; // Error: Property 'lastName' is missing... Property 'age' is missing... // greet(badUser);

searchDocs.title: 3.2 可选属性 (Optional Properties)​
searchDocs.content: 属性名后加 ? 表示该属性是可选的。  interface SquareConfig { color?: string; width?: number; } function createSquare(config: SquareConfig): { color: string; area: number } { let newSquare = { color: "white", area: 100 }; if (config.color) { newSquare.color = config.color; } if (config.width) { newSquare.area = config.width * config.width; } return newSquare; } let mySquare1 = createSquare({ color: "black" }); let mySquare2 = createSquare({ width: 20 }); let mySquare3 = createSquare({}); console.log(mySquare1, mySquare2, mySquare3);

searchDocs.title: 3.3 只读属性 (Readonly Properties)​
searchDocs.content: 属性名前加 readonly 表示该属性只能在对象首次创建时赋值，之后不能修改。  interface Point { readonly x: number; readonly y: number; } let p1: Point = { x: 10, y: 20 }; // p1.x = 5; // Error: Cannot assign to 'x' because it is a read-only property.

searchDocs.title: 3.4 函数类型 (Function Types)​
searchDocs.content: 接口也可以描述函数类型。  interface SearchFunc { (source: string, subString: string): boolean; } let mySearch: SearchFunc; mySearch = function (src, sub) { // 参数名不需要匹配 let result = src.search(sub); return result > -1; }; console.log(mySearch("hello world", "world")); // true

searchDocs.title: 3.5 可索引类型 (Indexable Types)​
searchDocs.content: 接口可以描述那些能够通过索引得到的类型，如数组和对象。  interface StringArray { [index: number]: string; // 索引签名：数字索引返回字符串 } let myArray: StringArray; myArray = ["Bob", "Fred"]; let myStr: string = myArray[0]; // OK interface Dictionary { [key: string]: any; // 索引签名：字符串索引返回任意类型 length: number; // 可以有其他确定名称的属性 // name: string; // Error: Property 'name' of type 'string' is not assignable to 'string' index type 'any'. // (If index signature type is more specific, e.g., string, then named properties must also be assignable) } let myDict: Dictionary = { prop1: "value1", prop2: 100, length: 2 }; console.log(myDict["prop1"]);

searchDocs.title: 3.6 类类型 (Class Types) - 实现接口​
searchDocs.content: 接口可以强制一个类去符合某种契约。使用 implements 关键字。  interface ClockInterface { currentTime: Date; setTime(d: Date): void; } class Clock implements ClockInterface { currentTime: Date = new Date(); setTime(d: Date) { this.currentTime = d; } constructor(h: number, m: number) {} } let clock = new Clock(10, 30); console.log(clock.currentTime);

searchDocs.title: 3.7 接口继承 (Extending Interfaces)​
searchDocs.content: 接口可以像类一样相互继承，允许你复用接口定义。  interface Shape { color: string; } interface PenStroke { penWidth: number; } interface Square extends Shape, PenStroke { // 可以继承多个接口 sideLength: number; } let square = {} as Square; // 类型断言 square.color = "blue"; square.sideLength = 10; square.penWidth = 5.0;

searchDocs.title: 4. 类 (Classes)​
searchDocs.content: TypeScript 支持基于类的面向对象编程，包括 ES6 中的类特性，并添加了如访问修饰符等功能。

searchDocs.title: 4.1 基本定义​
searchDocs.content: 使用 class 关键字。  class Greeter { greeting: string; // 属性 constructor(message: string) { // 构造函数 this.greeting = message; } greet() { // 方法 return "Hello, " + this.greeting; } } let greeter = new Greeter("world"); console.log(greeter.greet());

searchDocs.title: 4.2 继承 (Inheritance)​
searchDocs.content: 使用 extends 关键字实现继承。子类可以覆盖父类的方法，并使用 super 关键字调用父类的构造函数和方法。  class Animal { name: string; constructor(theName: string) { this.name = theName; } move(distanceInMeters: number = 0) { console.log(`${this.name} moved ${distanceInMeters}m.`); } } class Snake extends Animal { constructor(name: string) { super(name); } // 必须调用 super() move(distanceInMeters = 5) { // 覆盖父类方法 console.log("Slithering..."); super.move(distanceInMeters); // 调用父类方法 } } class Horse extends Animal { constructor(name: string) { super(name); } move(distanceInMeters = 45) { console.log("Galloping..."); super.move(distanceInMeters); } } let sam = new Snake("Sammy the Python"); let tom: Animal = new Horse("Tommy the Palomino"); // 可以用父类类型引用子类实例 sam.move(); tom.move(34);

searchDocs.title: 4.3 访问修饰符 (Access Modifiers)​
searchDocs.content: public (默认): 成员可以在任何地方被访问。private: 成员只能在其声明的类内部访问。protected: 成员只能在其声明的类及其子类中访问。  class Person { public name: string; // 显式 public private age: number; protected gender: string; constructor(name: string, age: number, gender: string) { this.name = name; this.age = age; this.gender = gender; } public getAge() { return this.age; // OK, 在类内部访问 private } } class Employee extends Person { private department: string; constructor(name: string, age: number, gender: string, department: string) { super(name, age, gender); this.department = department; } public getInfo() { // console.log(this.age); // Error: Property 'age' is private and only accessible within class 'Person'. console.log( `Name: ${this.name}, Gender: ${this.gender}, Dept: ${this.department}` ); // OK: public name, protected gender } } let person = new Person("Alice", 30, "female"); console.log(person.name); // OK // console.log(person.age); // Error: Property 'age' is private... // console.log(person.gender); // Error: Property 'gender' is protected... console.log(person.getAge()); // OK let emp = new Employee("Bob", 25, "male", "Sales"); emp.getInfo();   参数属性 (Parameter Properties): 可以在构造函数参数前添加访问修饰符，自动创建同名属性并赋值。  class Octopus { readonly numberOfLegs: number = 8; // 将 name 声明和赋值合并到构造函数参数 constructor(readonly name: string) {} } let dad = new Octopus("Man with the 8 strong legs"); // dad.name = "New Name"; // Error! name is readonly. console.log(dad.name);

searchDocs.title: 4.4 只读修饰符 (Readonly Modifier)​
searchDocs.content: readonly 关键字可以用在属性上，表示该属性只能在声明时或构造函数里被初始化。  class TestReadonly { readonly value: string; constructor(val: string) { this.value = val; // OK in constructor } changeValue() { // this.value = "new value"; // Error: Cannot assign to 'value' because it is a read-only property. } }

searchDocs.title: 4.5 存取器 (Accessors - Getters / Setters)​
searchDocs.content: 允许你像访问属性一样调用函数，用于控制属性的读取和设置。  let passcode = "secret passcode"; class EmployeePass { private _fullName: string = ""; get fullName(): string { console.log("Getter called"); return this._fullName; } set fullName(newName: string) { console.log("Setter called"); if (passcode && passcode === "secret passcode") { this._fullName = newName; } else { console.log("Error: Unauthorized update of employee!"); } } } let employee = new EmployeePass(); employee.fullName = "Bob Smith"; // 调用 setter if (employee.fullName) { // 调用 getter console.log(employee.fullName); }

searchDocs.title: 4.6 静态属性和方法 (Static Members)​
searchDocs.content: 使用 static 关键字定义的属性和方法属于类本身，而不是类的实例。通过类名直接访问。  class Grid { static origin = { x: 0, y: 0 }; // 静态属性 calculateDistanceFromOrigin(point: { x: number; y: number }) { let xDist = point.x - Grid.origin.x; // 访问静态属性 let yDist = point.y - Grid.origin.y; return Math.sqrt(xDist * xDist + yDist * yDist) / this.scale; } static createDefaultGrid() { // 静态方法 return new Grid(1.0); } constructor(public scale: number) {} } let grid1 = new Grid(1.0); let grid2 = new Grid(5.0); console.log(Grid.origin); // { x: 0, y: 0 } - 通过类名访问 let defaultGrid = Grid.createDefaultGrid(); // 调用静态方法 console.log(defaultGrid.calculateDistanceFromOrigin({ x: 10, y: 10 }));

searchDocs.title: 4.7 抽象类 (Abstract Classes)​
searchDocs.content: 抽象类作为其他派生类的基类使用。它们一般不会直接被实例化。不同于接口，抽象类可以包含成员的实现细节。abstract 关键字是用于定义抽象类和在抽象类内部定义抽象方法。抽象方法必须在派生类中实现。  abstract class Department { constructor(public name: string) {} printName(): void { console.log("Department name: " + this.name); } abstract printMeeting(): void; // 必须在派生类中实现 } class AccountingDepartment extends Department { constructor() { super("Accounting and Auditing"); // 在派生类的构造函数中必须调用 super() } printMeeting(): void { // 实现抽象方法 console.log("The Accounting Department meets each Monday at 10am."); } generateReports(): void { console.log("Generating accounting reports..."); } } let department: Department; // 允许创建一个对抽象类型的引用 // department = new Department(); // Error: Cannot create an instance of an abstract class. department = new AccountingDepartment(); // OK department.printName(); department.printMeeting(); // department.generateReports(); // Error: Property 'generateReports' does not exist on type 'Department'. (需要类型断言或用子类类型引用) (department as AccountingDepartment).generateReports(); // OK with type assertion

searchDocs.title: 5. 函数 (Functions)​
searchDocs.content: TypeScript 为 JavaScript 函数添加了类型注解和其他特性。

searchDocs.title: 5.1 函数类型注解​
searchDocs.content: 可以为函数的参数和返回值添加类型注解。  // 命名函数 function add(x: number, y: number): number { return x + y; } // 匿名函数 (函数表达式) let myAdd = function (x: number, y: number): number { return x + y; }; // 也可以只注解变量类型，TS 会尝试推断 let mySubtract: (baseValue: number, increment: number) => number = function ( x, y ) { return x - y; };

searchDocs.title: 5.2 可选参数和默认参数​
searchDocs.content: 可选参数: 参数名后加 ?。可选参数必须位于必选参数之后。默认参数: 参数后加 = 默认值。带默认值的参数被视为可选参数。  function buildName(firstName: string, lastName?: string): string { // lastName is optional if (lastName) { return firstName + " " + lastName; } else { return firstName; } } let result1 = buildName("Bob"); // OK, lastName is undefined let result2 = buildName("Bob", "Adams"); // OK // let result3 = buildName("Bob", "Adams", "Sr."); // Error: Expected 2 arguments, but got 3. function calculatePay(rate: number, hours: number = 40): number { // hours has default value return rate * hours; } let pay1 = calculatePay(15); // Uses default hours (40) -> 600 let pay2 = calculatePay(15, 20); // Uses provided hours (20) -> 300

searchDocs.title: 5.3 剩余参数 (Rest Parameters)​
searchDocs.content: 用于将多个参数收集到一个变量中（必须是数组类型）。剩余参数必须是参数列表中的最后一个。  function buildFullName(firstName: string, ...restOfName: string[]): string { return firstName + " " + restOfName.join(" "); } let employeeName = buildFullName("Joseph", "Samuel", "Lucas", "MacKinzie"); console.log(employeeName); // "Joseph Samuel Lucas MacKinzie"

searchDocs.title: 5.4 this 参数​
searchDocs.content: 有时需要明确指定函数中 this 的类型。this 参数是一个假的参数，它出现在参数列表的最前面。  interface Card { suit: string; card: number; } interface Deck { suits: string[]; cards: number[]; createCardPicker(this: Deck): () => Card; // Explicitly defining 'this' type for the function } let deck: Deck = { suits: ["hearts", "spades", "clubs", "diamonds"], cards: Array(52), // NOTE: The function now explicitly specifies that its callee must be of type Deck createCardPicker: function (this: Deck) { return () => { let pickedCard = Math.floor(Math.random() * 52); let pickedSuit = Math.floor(pickedCard / 13); // 'this' here refers to the 'Deck' object because of the arrow function's lexical scoping return { suit: this.suits[pickedSuit], card: pickedCard % 13 }; }; }, }; let cardPicker = deck.createCardPicker(); let pickedCard = cardPicker(); console.log("card: " + pickedCard.card + " of " + pickedCard.suit);

searchDocs.title: 5.5 函数重载 (Overloads)​
searchDocs.content: 允许为同一个函数根据不同的参数类型或数量提供多个函数签名（类型定义），然后提供一个通用的实现。  // Overload signatures function processInput(input: string): string; function processInput(input: number): number; function processInput(input: boolean): boolean; // Implementation signature (must be compatible with all overloads) function processInput( input: string | number | boolean ): string | number | boolean { if (typeof input === "string") { return `Processed string: ${input}`; } else if (typeof input === "number") { return input * 2; } else { return !input; } } let resultStr = processInput("hello"); // Type is inferred as string let resultNum = processInput(10); // Type is inferred as number let resultBool = processInput(true); // Type is inferred as boolean console.log(resultStr); console.log(resultNum); console.log(resultBool); // let resultErr = processInput(null); // Error: No overload matches this call.   注意: 实现签名 (function processInput(input: any)... 或使用联合类型) 本身不能被直接调用。编译器只认重载签名。

searchDocs.title: 6. 泛型 (Generics)​
searchDocs.content: 泛型允许你编写可重用的、适用于多种类型的组件（如函数、类、接口），同时保持类型安全。

searchDocs.title: 6.1 泛型函数​
searchDocs.content: 使用类型变量（如 <T>）来捕获用户提供的类型。  // <T> is the type parameter declaration function identity<T>(arg: T): T { return arg; } // Calling the generic function let output1 = identity<string>("myString"); // Explicitly specify type T as string let output2 = identity("myString"); // Type inference: T is inferred as string let output3 = identity<number>(100); // Explicitly specify type T as number let output4 = identity(100); // Type inference: T is inferred as number console.log(typeof output1, output1); // string myString console.log(typeof output4, output4); // number 100

searchDocs.title: 6.2 泛型接口​
searchDocs.content: 接口也可以是泛型的。  interface GenericIdentityFn<T> { (arg: T): T; } function identityAgain<T>(arg: T): T { return arg; } let myIdentity: GenericIdentityFn<number> = identityAgain; console.log(myIdentity(5)); // 5 // console.log(myIdentity("hello")); // Error: Argument of type 'string' is not assignable to parameter of type 'number'.

searchDocs.title: 6.3 泛型类​
searchDocs.content: 类也可以是泛型的。  class GenericNumber<T> { zeroValue: T | undefined; add: ((x: T, y: T) => T) | undefined; } let myGenericNumber = new GenericNumber<number>(); myGenericNumber.zeroValue = 0; myGenericNumber.add = function (x, y) { return x + y; }; console.log(myGenericNumber.add(myGenericNumber.zeroValue, 10)); // 10 let stringNumeric = new GenericNumber<string>(); stringNumeric.zeroValue = ""; stringNumeric.add = function (x, y) { return x + y; }; console.log(stringNumeric.add(stringNumeric.zeroValue, "test")); // "test"

searchDocs.title: 6.4 泛型约束 (Generic Constraints)​
searchDocs.content: 有时你希望限制泛型类型变量可以接受的类型范围。可以使用 extends 关键字添加约束。  interface Lengthwise { length: number; // Constraint: T must have a 'length' property } // T must have a .length property function loggingIdentity<T extends Lengthwise>(arg: T): T { console.log(arg.length); // Now we know it has a .length property, so no error return arg; } loggingIdentity("hello"); // OK, string has length loggingIdentity([1, 2, 3]); // OK, array has length loggingIdentity({ length: 10, value: 3 }); // OK, object has length property // loggingIdentity(3); // Error: Argument of type 'number' is not assignable to parameter of type 'Lengthwise'. (number doesn't have length) // loggingIdentity({ value: 3 }); // Error: Property 'length' is missing in type '{ value: number; }' but required in type 'Lengthwise'.

searchDocs.title: 7. 类型推断 (Type Inference)​
searchDocs.content: TypeScript 编译器可以在很多情况下自动推断出变量或表达式的类型，无需显式注解。  let x = 3; // TypeScript infers x as 'number' // x = "hello"; // Error: Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'number'. let y = [0, 1, null]; // TypeScript infers y as '(number | null)[]' // Contextual Typing: TS infers parameter types based on context window.onmousedown = function (mouseEvent /* Inferred as MouseEvent */) { // console.log(mouseEvent.button); // OK // console.log(mouseEvent.kangaroo); // Error: Property 'kangaroo' does not exist on type 'MouseEvent'. }; // Best Common Type: TS finds the best common type for multiple expressions let arr = [0, 1, "hello", null]; // Inferred as (string | number | null)[]

searchDocs.title: 8. 类型断言 (Type Assertions)​
searchDocs.content: 类型断言允许你覆盖 TypeScript 的类型推断，告诉编译器“相信我，我知道这个变量的类型”。它类似于其他语言中的类型转换，但没有运行时的影响，仅用于编译时检查。有两种语法：  尖括号语法: <Type>value (在 JSX 中不能使用)as 语法: value as Type (推荐，尤其是在 React/JSX 项目中)  let someValue: any = "this is a string"; // 1. Angle-bracket syntax let strLength1: number = (<string>someValue).length; // 2. as-syntax (preferred) let strLength2: number = (someValue as string).length; console.log(strLength1, strLength2); // Be careful: Assertions bypass checks, can lead to runtime errors if wrong let potentiallyWrong = 123; // console.log((potentiallyWrong as string).length); // Compiles, but throws TypeError at runtime

searchDocs.title: 9.1 联合类型 (Union Types)​
searchDocs.content: 表示一个值可以是几种类型之一，使用 | 分隔。  function printId(id: number | string) { console.log("Your ID is: " + id); // Need type guard to use type-specific methods if (typeof id === "string") { console.log(id.toUpperCase()); // OK, id is string here } else { console.log(id.toFixed(2)); // OK, id is number here } } printId(101); // OK printId("202"); // OK // printId({ myID: 22342 }); // Error

searchDocs.title: 9.2 交叉类型 (Intersection Types)​
searchDocs.content: 将多个类型合并为一个类型，包含所有类型的成员。使用 & 分隔。常用于混入 (mixins) 或其他不适合继承的场景。  interface Loggable { log(message: string): void; } interface Serializable { serialize(): string; } type LoggableSerializable = Loggable & Serializable; class ConsoleLogger implements Loggable { log(message: string) { console.log(message); } } class JsonSerialier implements Serializable { constructor(private data: any) {} serialize(): string { return JSON.stringify(this.data); } } // Helper function to mixin properties function extend<First extends {}, Second extends {}>( first: First, second: Second ): First & Second { const result: Partial<First & Second> = {}; for (const prop in first) { if (first.hasOwnProperty(prop)) { (result as First)[prop] = first[prop]; } } for (const prop in second) { if (second.hasOwnProperty(prop)) { (result as Second)[prop] = second[prop]; } } return result as First & Second; } class CombinedItem { constructor(private data: any) {} // Manually implement combined interface log(message: string) { console.log(`[LOG] ${message}: ${this.serialize()}`); } serialize(): string { return JSON.stringify(this.data); } } // Using the type let item: LoggableSerializable = new CombinedItem({ value: 42 }); item.log("Item data"); console.log(item.serialize());

searchDocs.title: 9.3 类型别名 (Type Aliases)​
searchDocs.content: 使用 type 关键字为类型创建一个新名字。可以用于原始类型、联合类型、交叉类型、元组或任何其他需要手写类型注解的地方。  type Point = { x: number; y: number }; type ID = string | number; type StringOrNumberArray = (string | number)[]; type Tree<T> = { // Type alias can also be generic value: T; left?: Tree<T>; right?: Tree<T>; }; let p: Point = { x: 10, y: 20 }; let userId: ID = "user-123"; userId = 456; let mixedArray: StringOrNumberArray = [1, "two", 3, "four"]; let stringTree: Tree<string> = { value: "root", left: { value: "left-child" }, };

searchDocs.title: 9.4 字面量类型 (Literal Types)​
searchDocs.content: 允许你指定变量必须具有的确切值。常与联合类型结合使用，构成“可辨识联合类型”。  type Easing = "ease-in" | "ease-out" | "ease-in-out"; // String literal union let animationTiming: Easing = "ease-in"; // OK // animationTiming = "linear"; // Error: Type '"linear"' is not assignable to type 'Easing'. type DiceRoll = 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6; // Numeric literal union let roll: DiceRoll = 4; // OK // roll = 7; // Error interface Circle { kind: "circle"; // Literal type property acts as a discriminant radius: number; } interface SquareShape { // Renamed to avoid conflict with built-in Square kind: "square"; sideLength: number; } type ShapeUnion = Circle | SquareShape; // Discriminated union function getArea(shape: ShapeUnion) { switch (shape.kind) { case "circle": return Math.PI * shape.radius ** 2; // TS knows shape is Circle here case "square": return shape.sideLength ** 2; // TS knows shape is SquareShape here } } console.log(getArea({ kind: "circle", radius: 10 })); console.log(getArea({ kind: "square", sideLength: 5 }));

searchDocs.title: 9.5 索引类型 (Index Types) 和 映射类型 (Mapped Types)​
searchDocs.content: 索引类型查询 (keyof): 获取一个类型所有公共属性名的联合类型。索引访问类型 (T[K]): 获取类型 T 的属性 K 的类型。映射类型: 基于一个现有类型创建新类型，对原类型的每个属性应用转换。  interface UserProfile { id: number; name: string; email?: string; isAdmin: boolean; } // 1. keyof type UserProfileKeys = keyof UserProfile; // "id" | "name" | "email" | "isAdmin" let key: UserProfileKeys = "name"; // OK // key = "age"; // Error // 2. Indexed Access Type (Lookup Type) type UserIdType = UserProfile["id"]; // number type UserNameOrEmail = UserProfile["name" | "email"]; // string | string | undefined -> string | undefined // 3. Mapped Types // Example: Make all properties readonly type ReadonlyUserProfile = { readonly [P in keyof UserProfile]: UserProfile[P]; }; // Equivalent to built-in Readonly<UserProfile> // Example: Make all properties optional type PartialUserProfile = { [P in keyof UserProfile]?: UserProfile[P]; }; // Equivalent to built-in Partial<UserProfile> // Example: Create a flags object based on keys type UserProfileFlags = { [P in keyof UserProfile]: boolean; }; /* Resulting type: { id: boolean; name: boolean; email?: boolean; // Optionality is preserved if source has it isAdmin: boolean; } */ let userFlags: UserProfileFlags = { id: true, name: false, isAdmin: true }; // email is optional // More complex example: Nullable properties type Nullable<T> = { [P in keyof T]: T[P] | null; }; type NullableUserProfile = Nullable<UserProfile>; let nullableUser: NullableUserProfile = { id: 1, name: null, email: "test@example.com", isAdmin: null, };

searchDocs.title: 9.6 条件类型 (Conditional Types)​
searchDocs.content: 允许根据条件选择两种可能的类型之一，形式为 T extends U ? X : Y。  // Example: Extract specific types from a union type NonNullable<T> = T extends null | undefined ? never : T; type T0 = NonNullable<string | number | undefined>; // string | number type T1 = NonNullable<string[] | null | undefined>; // string[] // Example: Flatten array type type Flatten<T> = T extends Array<infer Item> ? Item : T; // 'infer Item' declares a new generic type variable 'Item' within the 'true' branch type Str = Flatten<string[]>; // string type Num = Flatten<number>; // number (not an array, so returns T itself) // Example within a generic function signature declare function process<T extends any[] | string>( data: T ): T extends any[] ? T[number] : T; let item = process([1, 2, 3]); // item type is 'number' (T[number] for array) let strItem = process("hello"); // strItem type is 'string' (T for string) // Built-in conditional types: Exclude, Extract, NonNullable, ReturnType, InstanceType type T2 = Exclude<"a" | "b" | "c", "a">; // "b" | "c" type T3 = Extract<"a" | "b" | "c", "a" | "f">; // "a" type T4 = ReturnType<() => string>; // string

searchDocs.title: 9.7 工具类型 (Utility Types)​
searchDocs.content: TypeScript 提供了一些内置的工具类型，用于常见的类型转换（许多基于映射类型和条件类型实现）。  Partial<T>: 将 T 的所有属性设为可选。Required<T>: 将 T 的所有属性设为必选。Readonly<T>: 将 T 的所有属性设为只读。Record<K, T>: 创建一个对象类型，其属性键为 K 类型，属性值为 T 类型。Pick<T, K>: 从 T 中选择一组属性 K 来构造新类型。Omit<T, K>: 从 T 中排除一组属性 K 来构造新类型。Exclude<T, U>: 从 T 中排除可分配给 U 的类型。Extract<T, U>: 从 T 中提取可分配给 U 的类型。NonNullable<T>: 从 T 中排除 null 和 undefined。Parameters<T>: 获取函数类型 T 的参数类型组成的元组。ConstructorParameters<T>: 获取构造函数类型 T 的参数类型组成的元组。ReturnType<T>: 获取函数类型 T 的返回值类型。InstanceType<T>: 获取构造函数类型 T 的实例类型。  interface Todo { title: string; description: string; completed: boolean; createdAt: number; } // Partial: Make all properties optional type PartialTodo = Partial<Todo>; // { title?: string; description?: string; completed?: boolean; createdAt?: number; } // Required: Make all properties required (useful if original had optionals) // type RequiredTodo = Required<PartialTodo>; // { title: string; description: string; completed: boolean; createdAt: number; } // Readonly: Make all properties readonly type ReadonlyTodo = Readonly<Todo>; // { readonly title: string; readonly description: string; readonly completed: boolean; readonly createdAt: number; } // Record: Create a dictionary-like type type PageInfo = { title: string; visited: boolean }; type Pages = "home" | "about" | "contact"; const navInfo: Record<Pages, PageInfo> = { home: { title: "Home", visited: true }, about: { title: "About", visited: false }, contact: { title: "Contact", visited: false }, }; // Pick: Select specific properties type TodoPreview = Pick<Todo, "title" | "completed">; // { title: string; completed: boolean; } // Omit: Remove specific properties type TodoInfo = Omit<Todo, "completed" | "createdAt">; // { title: string; description: string; } // Parameters: Get function parameter types type PointPrinterParams = Parameters<(p: { x: number; y: number }) => void>; // [(p: { x: number; y: number })] let params: PointPrinterParams = [{ x: 1, y: 2 }]; // ReturnType: Get function return type type GreetingReturnType = ReturnType<() => string>; // string let greetingResult: GreetingReturnType = "hello";

searchDocs.title: 10. 模块 (Modules)​
